Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade deals his main damage and knocks you up, so when you see the cast, dodge outside or inside the blade’s edge. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, walk out of its area immediately. If you risk being pulled back, use Irelia Q Bladesurge to escape. Aatrox R World Ender increases his attack damage and healing, so create distance and wait out its duration.
Aatrox.fight: Build Ionian Fervor stacks on minions first, then go in for a short trade and back off. Engage just after Aatrox uses his Deathbringer Stance empowered attack on a minion or Aatrox E Umbral Dash. When you see Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, use Irelia Q Bladesurge to get inside the blade’s edge. Use Irelia E Flawless Duet for interruption during a counterattack or an escape.
Aatrox.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to reset its cooldown and preserve an escape route. If you avoid giving up an early kill and keep farming, the matchup gets easier as the game goes on.
Aatrox.combo: Hit the marked target with Irelia Q Bladesurge to reset its cooldown, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance against Aatrox’s counterattack. Before going in, check whether there is a low-health minion you can use to escape with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Aatrox.phase: After that, Irelia gets stronger as she builds more items, but dying on an overaggressive engage costs her that scaling momentum.
Aatrox.teamfight: After your team lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to split the enemy formation where Aatrox is positioned. Lock down a target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then use marked targets and minions to chain Irelia Q Bladesurge into the backline. While Aatrox R World Ender is active, even an even-health duel can turn against you, so don’t fight him head-on for long.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and W Infernal Chains. If Aatrox’s healing makes short trades ineffective, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items. Add some penetration as well, since Aatrox’s high armor blocks much of Irelia’s physical damage.
Aatrox.escape: Right after you make Aatrox use E Umbral Dash is your chance to close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet then, making it difficult for Aatrox to escape. Keep a route for Irelia Q Bladesurge to retreat in case of Aatrox W Infernal Chains.

Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits you, you can take her full follow-up combo, so move with a minion wave between you. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit you on its return, so keep moving outside its return path even after dodging the first pass.
Ahri.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ahri deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Keep in mind that resistance cannot reduce the true damage dealt when Ahri Q Orb of Deception returns.
Ahri.fight: Hit minions with abilities to build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks, then trade when Ahri E Charm is down. Approach by finishing a low-health minion with Irelia Q Bladesurge, stun her with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then use the mark to follow up with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Ahri.laning: Against ranged Ahri, don’t force trades. Farm behind minions while dodging Ahri E Charm. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to keep its cooldown reset available, and leave a minion to ride when you retreat. Wasting Irelia E Flawless Duet trying to force an engage leaves you vulnerable to ganks.
Ahri.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge and land basic attacks, then follow up again with Irelia Q Bladesurge reset by the mark. If Ahri counters or a gank comes in, reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Ahri.escape: Right after you dodge Ahri E Charm is your chance to engage. Don’t chase recklessly if Ahri R Spirit Rush is available or Charm is still up.
Ahri.phase: In the mid and late game, choose moments when Ahri E Charm and R Spirit Rush are down to engage, and don’t lose your scaling by forcing an engage.
Ahri.teamfight: After your team lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to cut off Ahri’s escape route and split the enemy formation. If Ahri E Charm is down, lock her down with Irelia E Flawless Duet and dive in with a chain of Irelia Q Bladesurge casts using marks. If the enemy uses abilities first or dives onto Irelia, reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance.

Akali.watch: If a mark is applied, the second dash follows Irelia as she tries to escape.
Akali.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Akali deals mostly magic damage, and Irelia has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Also build enough total health to withstand the second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution.
Akali.fight: Build passive stacks in advance and trade with Akali in short bursts. When Akali comes out of W Twilight Shroud to attack, fight back. Save Irelia E Flawless Duet for stuns during a counterattack or an escape. Don’t use Irelia Q Bladesurge to engage first on Akali when she isn’t marked.
Akali.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge only to finish low-health minions to keep its reset available, and check first for minions you can use to engage or retreat.
Akali.combo: Land basic attacks, then follow up with Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Akali.escape: Look to engage when both Akali W Twilight Shroud and E Shuriken Flip are down. In particular, before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back, close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge and stun her with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Check for a minion to use when escaping and whether Irelia Q Bladesurge has reset.
Akali.phase: From the mid game onward, time Irelia W Defiant Dance to Akali’s engage, and don’t lose your scaling by forcing an engage.
Akali.teamfight: After your team lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to block Akali’s escape route and split the formation. Stun a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then follow up with consecutive Irelia Q Bladesurge casts. If Akali dives in first, reduce the damage with your saved Irelia W Defiant Dance.

Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits an enemy, so dodge both its outgoing and return paths, even from behind minions. Akshan E Heroic Swing uses walls to engage and disengage, so don’t chase recklessly near walls. When you’re low on health and see Akshan R Comeuppance aiming, dodge behind terrain.
Akshan.build: Build armor first because the main damage from Akshan Q Avengerang, E Heroic Swing, and R Comeuppance is physical. Basic attacks and attack speed are also important to Akshan’s damage, so effects that reduce attack speed help.
Akshan.fight: Right after Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, close the gap by using Irelia Q Bladesurge on a minion you can finish. Hit minions with abilities in advance to build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks, then stun Akshan with Irelia E Flawless Duet and trade. Don’t engage by casting Irelia Q Bladesurge first on Akshan when he isn’t marked.
Akshan.laning: Rather than forcing an engage on ranged Akshan, farm by chaining Irelia Q Bladesurge through minions you can finish. Don’t stay only behind the minion wave to dodge Akshan Q Avengerang; watch its return path after he throws it, too. Using Irelia E Flawless Duet recklessly leaves you vulnerable to an immediate gank, so save it when you don’t have an opening to engage.
Akshan.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and follow up with Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Akshan.phase: From the mid game onward, make the opponent use abilities first, then fight while reducing damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance. The provided information is not enough to determine who has the advantage in the late game.
Akshan.teamfight: After your team lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to block Akshan’s escape route, then lock him down with Irelia E Flawless Duet and follow up with Irelia Q Bladesurge. If you get marked as a Scoundrel after killing one of Akshan’s allies, don’t face Akshan alone or fight at low health within his finishing range. Maintain vision around the river and jungle walls to spot an approach while Akshan W Going Rogue is camouflaging him.
Akshan.escape: Right after you make Akshan use E Heroic Swing is your window to close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Hit him with Irelia E Flawless Duet then to make it difficult for Akshan to escape. Before going in, check the minion positions for a way back out with Irelia Q Bladesurge.

Annie.watch: When white light swirls around Annie, Annie P Pyromania is ready to stun, so stay out of her ability range. In teamfights, spread out so several allies aren’t caught in Annie R Summon: Tibbers’s area stun. After Tibbers is summoned, don’t stay where it landed, even if you’ve killed Annie.
Annie.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Annie deals mostly magic damage, and Irelia has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize building magic resistance.
Annie.laning: Early on, don’t force your way onto ranged Annie; use Irelia Q Bladesurge resets to safely collect CS. Use Q on minions you can finish, and don’t waste Irelia E Flawless Duet. Keep your distance when Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, then pressure her after she uses it.
Annie.combo: E’s mark resets Q’s cooldown, so you can use Q to follow up again before the stun wears off. If Annie retaliates, activate Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Annie.escape: The moment Annie P Pyromania’s stun is used is your chance to engage. Annie has no mobility, so close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge and pin her down with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Before disengaging, check whether there are minions you can finish with Q.
Annie.phase: You get stronger as you build items in the mid and late game, but don’t lose that growth through reckless engages.
Annie.teamfight: Don’t stand on top of your allies when Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready or Annie is out of sight. After your team’s crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to block Annie’s escape route, pin her down with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then follow up with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Don’t stay where Annie R Summon: Tibbers landed.
Annie.fight: Once Annie P Pyromania’s stun is down, close the gap by finishing off low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Just before engaging, hit minions with abilities to build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks, then stun Annie with Irelia E Flawless Duet and attack. Use Irelia W Defiant Dance to reduce the damage when Annie retaliates.

Ambessa.watch: Stop attacking and move out of range when you see the shield and windup for Ambessa W Repudiation. The blade tips of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam are dangerous, so dodge the first hit or move close to her if it’s hard to avoid. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, don’t wait for the slow to wear off; move immediately with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Ambessa.build: Ambessa deals mostly physical damage, so prioritize armor if you’re building resistance. Be wary of relying on health alone, since Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam deals damage based on max health. If Ambessa’s healing keeps negating your short trades, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Ambessa.laning: Reset the cooldown by last-hitting low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge, and check for minion paths you can use to engage and retreat. Don’t spam Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can’t finish or dash first onto an unmarked Ambessa.
Ambessa.escape: If Ambessa E Lacerate is down, you don’t need to worry as much about being caught by its slow. Stun her with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Before going in, also check for a retreat path using low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Ambessa.phase: Be especially careful not to give up a kill while Ambessa is building her core items in the mid game. After that, take advantage of how Irelia grows stronger as she builds items.
Ambessa.teamfight: After your team’s crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split Ambessa’s escape route and the enemy formation. Hit the trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then chain in with Irelia Q Bladesurge. When facing off, position so your team’s backline isn’t at the end of Ambessa R Public Execution’s line.
Ambessa.combo: When you see the windup for Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking. Use Irelia W Defiant Dance as the retaliation damage comes in.
Ambessa.fight: Fully stack Irelia P Ionian Fervor in advance, then briefly engage and disengage right after Ambessa spends her abilities and charges. Don’t attack while Ambessa W Repudiation is readying; move out of its range. Stun Ambessa with Irelia E Flawless Duet when she retaliates or moves, then follow up with Irelia Q Bladesurge after the mark appears.

Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again as the curses are drawn back, and that damage increases the more health you’ve lost. If you’re cursed, move out of the line between you and Aurora, and if your health is low, back off before the curses are drawn back. After Aurora R Between Worlds opens, you’re slowed when leaving, so decide whether to get out before the zone forms or fight inside it.
Aurora.build: Early on, withstand the pressure with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Aurora deals mostly magic damage, and Irelia has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Aurora P Spirit Abjuration’s healing keeps negating your short trades, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Aurora.fight: Before engaging, hit minions with abilities to build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge to last-hit low-health minions and close the gap; once Aurora E The Weirding and W Across the Veil are down, stun her with Irelia E Flawless Duet and engage. If health has decreased while affected by Aurora Q Twofold Hex, don’t force the trade to continue.
Aurora.laning: Against ranged Aurora, when there’s no opening to engage, safely last-hit only minions you can finish with a chain of Irelia Q Bladesurge casts. Don’t spam Q and lose your way to escape, or force your way in and waste Irelia E Flawless Duet.
Aurora.combo: Using Q on Aurora while she’s marked by E resets its cooldown, letting you follow up again.
Aurora.escape: Bait out Aurora E The Weirding, then look for an opening to re-engage with Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Aurora W Across the Veil is also down and Aurora R Between Worlds isn’t back up yet, it’s a good time to pin her down with Irelia E Flawless Duet and engage. If Aurora uses W to become stealthed, don’t cast abilities into empty space; wait until she’s revealed.
Aurora.phase: Irelia gets stronger as she builds items in the mid and late game, so don’t lose that growth by repeatedly forcing bad engages.
Aurora.teamfight: After your team’s crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the enemy formation, then pin the trapped Aurora down with Irelia E Flawless Duet and follow up with Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Aurora used her leap to engage and nobody died, that’s your chance to catch her. If an ally is killed, Aurora’s leap cooldown resets, so don’t leave low-health allies behind when retreating.

AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on max health, and hitting you for a long time adds extra damage and stardust. Stand behind minions to reduce the damage and quickly move out of its aim line. If your health is low, avoid Aurelion Sol E Singularity’s execution range; if you’re caught, move outside immediately. In the late game, Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend can be empowered with a knockup and area shockwave, so keep your distance from allies.
AurelionSol.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Aurelion Sol’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
AurelionSol.fight: Just before engaging, hit minions with abilities to fully stack Irelia P Ionian Fervor. Once Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge and stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet.
AurelionSol.laning: Don’t force your way through ranged poke; safely collect CS using Irelia Q Bladesurge only on minions you can finish. Dodge Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light from behind minions, and don’t give him stardust with pointless poke. Check the minion positions for paths to engage and retreat, and don’t waste Irelia E Flawless Duet when there’s a risk of a gank.
AurelionSol.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge and land basic attacks before using Irelia W Defiant Dance. Irelia E Flawless Duet’s mark resets Irelia Q Bladesurge’s cooldown, letting you follow up again.
AurelionSol.escape: Right after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down is your chance to engage. Close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge and pin him down with Irelia E Flawless Duet, but if you enter Aurelion Sol E Singularity, don’t force the fight; move outside immediately.
AurelionSol.phase: Irelia also gets stronger as she builds items in the mid game, but don’t rack up deaths through reckless engages. Aurelion Sol P Cosmic Creator’s stardust is permanent, so it becomes harder to kill him with the same engage angle as the game goes on.
AurelionSol.teamfight: After your team’s crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the enemy formation and block their escape route. Stun a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then follow them into the backline with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Before engaging, keep your distance from allies so several of you aren’t hit by the empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.

Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost explodes when recast and stuns, so don’t just sidestep the projectile; use Irelia Q Bladesurge to get outside the blast radius. If you’ve been hit by Q or are inside Anivia R Glacial Storm after it has grown large enough, Anivia E Frostbite deals much more damage. Don’t keep fighting in that state; get out of the storm.
Anivia.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Anivia’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If Anivia P Rebirth keeps negating your short trades through its healing, slot Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Anivia.fight: Approach by finishing low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge, then engage after stunning Anivia with Irelia E Flawless Duet. If Anivia P Rebirth is still available, don’t overextend trying to break the egg alone; pressure her with your allies.
Anivia.laning: Rather than forcing your way onto ranged Anivia, safely farm by using Irelia Q Bladesurge only on minions you can finish. Check the minion positions you can use to approach and retreat, and be especially wary of ganks right after wasting Irelia E Flawless Duet. Trade in a wide lane instead of a narrow path where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape.
Anivia.combo: Just before a fight, hit minions with abilities to build stacks of Irelia P Ionian Fervor. Place the first blade of Irelia E Flawless Duet behind Anivia or along her escape route, stun her with the second blade, then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge and land basic attacks. You can follow up with Irelia Q Bladesurge after the mark resets its cooldown. Use Irelia W Defiant Dance when Anivia retaliates.
Anivia.escape: A missed Anivia Q Flash Frost is your chance to engage, since the stun threat is reduced. Anivia has no mobility, so close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge through minions and lock her down with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Save Flash when engaging in narrow paths where Anivia W Crystallize could split you from your allies.
Anivia.teamfight: Avoid narrow paths in the jungle or by the river, where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape, and start fights in open areas. After your allies land crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to divide the enemy formation and cut off escape routes, then follow the target locked down by Irelia E Flawless Duet with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Attack Anivia P Rebirth’s egg with your allies to make sure you break it.

Azir.watch: Don’t stand in the straight path of soldiers summoned by Azir W Arise! After Azir Q Conquering Sands moves them, circle to their side or behind them. In narrow corridors, Azir R Emperor’s Divide can knock back your engage and block the path, so don’t rush in from one direction as a group.
Azir.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Azir’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots, and prioritize magic resistance over armor.
Azir.fight: Trade briefly after Azir Q Conquering Sands moves his soldiers and they stop in place. Before engaging, hit minions with abilities to build stacks of Irelia P Ionian Fervor, stun Azir with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Azir.laning: Don’t force trades against ranged Azir. Grow safely by using Irelia Q Bladesurge only to finish low-health minions and keep its resets available. Pressure him when his soldiers expire or he runs low on mana, and don’t leave yourself vulnerable to ganks by wasting Irelia E Flawless Duet.
Azir.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Azir.teamfight: In an open area, after your allies land crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the formation around Azir. Lock down a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet and chain Irelia Q Bladesurge to dive into the backline. Engage from multiple directions so you aren’t all knocked back by Azir R Emperor’s Divide.
Azir.escape: Right after you make Azir use E Shifting Sands is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge and lock him down with Irelia E Flawless Duet. While Azir R Emperor's Divide is available, he can knock you back, so don’t charge straight at him in a narrow passage.

Cassiopeia.watch: If you’re hit by Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, Cassiopeia E Twin Fang deals more damage and heals more while you’re poisoned, so get out of range and reengage after the poison ends. You can’t use Irelia Q Bladesurge inside Cassiopeia W Miasma, so go around without stepping into the cloud. When you see Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze’s casting animation, turn your back to avoid the stun.
Cassiopeia.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Cassiopeia deals mainly magic damage, and Irelia has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Cassiopeia E Twin Fang’s healing keeps negating your short trades, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Cassiopeia.fight: Create a path by finishing low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Build stacks of Irelia P Ionian Fervor by hitting minions with abilities before trading. Engage with Irelia E Flawless Duet to stun Cassiopeia and Irelia Q Bladesurge to close in when Cassiopeia W Miasma has been used elsewhere or the poison has ended. Don’t engage by using Irelia Q Bladesurge first without a mark.
Cassiopeia.laning: Check the positions of low-health minions before both engaging and retreating.
Cassiopeia.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Cassiopeia.escape: The moment after Cassiopeia W Miasma is used elsewhere is your chance to engage with Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, back off until the poison ends, then engage. When Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze is cast, turn your back to avoid the stun, then look for another opening.
Cassiopeia.phase: If you don’t build a lead early, be wary of Cassiopeia’s sustained damage in the mid and late game and avoid forcing engages.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Rather than pushing straight in, cut off Cassiopeia’s path or look for an opening right after Cassiopeia W Miasma is used elsewhere. Once your allies land crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the formation and cut off escape routes, stun Cassiopeia with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then follow up with Irelia Q Bladesurge.

Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he can follow up with Darius W Crippling Strike and Darius Q Decimate, so poke from outside its range. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the blade’s edge or get close to reduce its healing. If stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage build up, create distance to let them expire. When low on health, get completely outside Darius R Noxian Guillotine’s range.
Darius.build: Build armor first to withstand Darius P Hemorrhage, Darius Q Decimate, and Darius W Crippling Strike. Also build health to account for Darius E Apprehend’s penetration and the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine. If Darius Q Decimate’s healing keeps negating your short trades, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Darius.fight: Fill Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks in advance, then briefly engage and disengage when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. You can also trade right after he uses Darius Q Decimate to clear minions. Use Irelia E Flawless Duet to interrupt Darius’s retaliation or retreat, and disengage before stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage build up.
Darius.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge only on low-health minions to reset its cooldown, and check the positions of minions you can use to engage or retreat. Keep an Irelia Q Bladesurge path open to respond to Darius E Apprehend, and watch for the enemy jungler’s approach.
Darius.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Darius.escape: Engage when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. Check for a path through low-health minions that lets you use Irelia Q Bladesurge to retreat if needed.
Darius.phase: Irelia gets stronger as she completes items in the mid game and beyond, but avoid long fights that let Darius build stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage, even in the late game.
Darius.teamfight: After your allies land crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the enemy formation. Lock down a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet and chain Irelia Q Bladesurge to dive into the backline. If health drops while stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage are present, Darius R Noxian Guillotine can lead to successive kills, so get out of range.

Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot lets her engage from long range using a wall and stun you, so stand away from walls. When Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum begins, don’t waste your crowd control; wait out the time you’re trapped, then counterattack.
Camille.build: Build armor first against Camille’s main damage. Resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, and Camille W Tactical Sweep deals damage based on your max health, so avoid relying on a large health increase alone. If Camille W Tactical Sweep’s healing keeps negating short trades, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Camille.fight: Fill Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks on minions in advance, then briefly engage and disengage after Camille P Adaptive Defenses’ shield has been removed. If Camille engages with E Hookshot, reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance and look for a chance to counterattack.
Camille.laning: Stand among minions and away from walls to limit Camille E Hookshot’s engage angles. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to preserve resets, and look to gain lane control and pressure her farming before Camille completes her first core item.
Camille.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, use basic attacks, and follow with Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Camille.escape: The window after Camille E Hookshot is down is a chance to engage, but Camille can escape with R The Hextech Ultimatum if it’s still available. In particular, before Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum comes back up, close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge, which can reset, and cut off her escape with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Before going in, check the positions of low-health minions so you have an escape route with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Camille.phase: From mid game onward, you need to stop Camille from quickly taking side lane turrets. The available information isn’t enough to determine who has the advantage in the late game.
Camille.teamfight: After an ally lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the enemy formation, including Camille. Bind a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then dive into the backline through a chain of Irelia Q Bladesurge resets using marks and minions.

Chogath.watch: Cho’Gath Q Rupture knocks you up after a warning appears beneath you, so move sideways when you see the indicator and save Irelia Q Bladesurge to dodge it. If Cho’Gath W Feral Scream silences you, you can’t escape with a mobility spell, so avoid facing him head-on; if it hits, walk out of range first. If your health is at or below half, get out of range of Cho’Gath R Feast, which deals true damage.
Chogath.build: Cho’Gath’s main damage is magic, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and build magic resistance. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. If Cho’Gath P Carnivore’s healing keeps negating short trades, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Chogath.fight: Build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks in advance and repeat short trades where you engage and disengage. After dodging Cho’Gath Q Rupture or once Cho’Gath W Feral Scream is down, stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet and close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Save Irelia E Flawless Duet to interrupt Cho’Gath when he tries to counterattack or escape.
Chogath.laning: Stand off the line where Cho’Gath E Vorpal Spikes can hit both you and the minions, and look for an opening outside the range of Cho’Gath Q Rupture. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge only on low-health minions to preserve resets and a path to move along, and apply early pressure to limit Cho’Gath’s chances to build stacks.
Chogath.combo: Use Irelia W Defiant Dance to reduce damage when Cho’Gath counterattacks.
Chogath.escape: Look to engage if Cho’Gath used Q Rupture on the wave or you dodged it, and Cho’Gath W Feral Scream is also down. Cho’Gath has no mobility spell, so bind him with Irelia E Flawless Duet and close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Before going in, check the positions of low-health minions to leave yourself a way out with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Chogath.phase: In mid game, you get stronger as you complete items, but avoid dying to reckless engages. Cho’Gath gets stronger as he builds stacks, making him harder to deal with as the game goes on, so pressure him early and avoid being killed by Cho’Gath R Feast when your health is in a precarious range.
Chogath.teamfight: After an ally lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the formation around Cho’Gath and block his escape route. Bind a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then dive in with consecutive Irelia Q Bladesurge casts. Irelia is easy to focus, so don’t engage recklessly first; if your health is at or below half, stay out of range of Cho’Gath R Feast.

Corki.build: Build armor first against the damage from Corki E Gatling Gun and Corki R Missile Barrage. Resistance does not help against the true damage from Corki P Hextech Munitions, so consider health as well. Moving out of Corki E Gatling Gun’s range takes priority over building more resistance.
Corki.fight: Right before a fight, hit minions with abilities to build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks. When Corki W Valkyrie is down, bind him with Irelia E Flawless Duet and close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Don’t use Irelia Q Bladesurge on Corki first without a mark.
Corki.laning: Instead of recklessly closing in on ranged Corki, secure CS by using Irelia Q Bladesurge to finish low-health minions and preserve resets. If you waste Irelia E Flawless Duet, you become vulnerable to ganks, so check the minion positions and whether Corki has used W Valkyrie before engaging. Look for chances to pressure Corki during the first five levels so he can’t farm comfortably.
Corki.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Corki.escape: The window to engage opens right after Corki W Valkyrie is down. Close the gap then with Irelia Q Bladesurge and stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet to limit his chance to escape.
Corki.phase: Corki also gets stronger as he completes items, so it’s important not to let him farm comfortably in the mid to late game and give him time to fire Corki R Missile Barrage.
Corki.teamfight: After an ally lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the formation around Corki and cut off his escape route. Stun a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then dive in through a chain of Irelia Q Bladesurge resets using marks. Before engaging, also check the minion positions you can use to escape.
Corki.watch: Corki E Gatling Gun reduces armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of trying to withstand it head-on. Corki R Missile Barrage can splash damage behind minions, so back out of range and reposition to avoid being hit by the third missile in quick succession. If you’re retreating after being hit by Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, immediately create distance with Irelia Q Bladesurge while your position is revealed.

Diana.build: Diana’s damage is mainly magic, and Irelia has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Diana.fight: Right before a fight, hit minions with abilities to fill Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks, then trade briefly and disengage. Fight after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone, and save Irelia E Flawless Duet to interrupt Diana when she counterattacks or tries to escape. When Diana dives in, absorb her combo with Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Diana.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to leave yourself a path to move along.
Diana.combo: Activate Irelia W Defiant Dance when Diana dives in to counterattack.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages first with E Lunar Rush without a mark from Q Crescent Strike, she has used her mobility, so stun her with Irelia E Flawless Duet and close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Diana Q Crescent Strike hits you, create distance because Diana E Lunar Rush can reset. After dodging Diana R Moonfall or once she has used it, look for an engage without having to watch for its forced pull.
Diana.phase: From mid game onward, make the opponent use their abilities first, then absorb them with Irelia W Defiant Dance. Avoid reckless engages that cost you your growth through the late game.
Diana.teamfight: Watch your engage angle and spread out to prevent multiple allies from being pulled in by Diana R Moonfall, while securing vision on the flanks. After an ally lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the enemy formation, bind a target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, and dive in through consecutive Irelia Q Bladesurge casts.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies, so dodge sideways instead of backing straight away. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush can reset, so move away from where you were hit. Don’t engage right after Diana activates W Pale Cascade; wait for the orbs and shield to expire.

DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits the first target and deals damage based on their current health, so be especially careful when your health is high and stand behind minions. Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma deals damage with an empowered basic attack, and Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage increases his healing and movement speed, so don’t force a kill when he activates it.
DrMundo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If Dr. Mundo’s healing keeps negating your short trades, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
DrMundo.fight: Fill Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks in advance by hitting minions with abilities, then repeat short trades where you engage and disengage. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, it negates the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet, so draw out his passive first, then use E to interrupt Dr. Mundo when he counterattacks or tries to escape.
DrMundo.laning: Stand with minions between you and Dr. Mundo to block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can kill to keep a path open, and when backing off after a trade, step on the canister Dr. Mundo drops to prevent his healing and passive cooldown reduction.
DrMundo.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, use basic attacks and Irelia W Defiant Dance, and use the Q reset from your E mark to keep chasing.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so when his passive is down and you have an opening to engage, close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Before retreating, first check whether you can kill a low-health minion with Q to continue moving.
DrMundo.teamfight: After an ally lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to split the enemy formation and block their escape route. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, lock him down with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then use a chain of Irelia Q Bladesurge resets from marks to reach the backline.

Fizz.watch: Fizz E Playful / Trickster can be used both to attack and escape, so don’t rush Irelia E Flawless Duet while it’s available. If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from allies before the shark bursts.
Fizz.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Fizz’s primary damage is magic and Irelia’s magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first.
Fizz.fight: Before a melee trade, build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks by hitting minions with abilities, then engage briefly and disengage. Right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster has been fully spent, stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet and attack. If Fizz dives in first, reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance and look for a chance to counterattack.
Fizz.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can kill to secure its cooldown reset and keep a path open. If Fizz misses a last hit with an empowered basic attack from W Seastone Trident and the ability goes on its full cooldown, trade with him.
Fizz.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, use basic attacks, and cast Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Fizz.escape: Don’t engage just because Fizz Q Urchin Strike is down. When Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down and unavailable again, close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge and catch him with Irelia E Flawless Duet.
Fizz.phase: At every stage of the game, wait for Fizz E Playful / Trickster to be down so you don’t keep dying from forced engages.
Fizz.teamfight: Stay close to an ally to bait out Fizz E Playful / Trickster first, and if Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from allies. After an ally lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to split the enemy formation, then lock down a target with Irelia E Flawless Duet and dive in with Irelia Q Bladesurge.

Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the area to avoid the stun and shield. Step out of the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder, and if you see the afterimage from Ekko R Chronobreak, don’t force a chase even at low health.
Ekko.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ekko’s primary damage is magic and Irelia’s magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first.
Ekko.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can kill to reset its cooldown, and leave a minion to ride when you retreat. Don’t enter the area where you saw the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence.
Ekko.escape: Right after Ekko E Phase Dive has been fully spent, his mobility ability is unavailable, giving you a chance to stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Once Ekko R Chronobreak is also down, close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge to begin the main engagement. Enter after avoiding the stun area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence.
Ekko.phase: Even from the mid game onward, avoid forcing a chase while Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, and look for an opening while it is down.
Ekko.teamfight: After an ally lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to block Ekko’s escape route and split the enemy formation. Right after Ekko uses E Phase Dive to get in, lock him down with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then chain Irelia Q Bladesurge casts using marks and minions.
Ekko.fight: Fully stack Irelia P Ionian Fervor by hitting minions with abilities, then repeat short trades where you engage and disengage. If Ekko engages with E Phase Dive, interrupt his retaliation with Irelia E Flawless Duet, and absorb his diving combo with Irelia W Defiant Dance.

Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte can block the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet and stun you in return, so don’t use E carelessly while Riposte is available. If Fiora Q Lunge comes in from the direction of a vital, stand on the opposite side to narrow her angle, and if you are hit by Fiora R Grand Challenge, stand against a wall to block one vital.
Fiora.build: Build armor first against Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. If short trades keep getting negated by healing from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Fiora.fight: Use minions to build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks in advance, then engage briefly and disengage. After Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora W Riposte are down, lock her down with Irelia E Flawless Duet and follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Don’t force a chase after the trade.
Fiora.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can kill to maintain its reset, and check the wave position both when engaging and retreating. Don’t dash first with Q onto Fiora if she has no mark.
Fiora.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, use basic attacks, and cast Irelia W Defiant Dance. If she has an E mark, use Q’s cooldown reset to follow again.
Fiora.escape: Right after making Fiora use Q Lunge is your chance to close the gap. If Fiora W Riposte is also down, look for a stun with Irelia E Flawless Duet and engage with Irelia Q Bladesurge. When you need to retreat, kill a low-health minion with Q to create a path.
Fiora.phase: In the mid game, build your items without stacking deaths from forced engages.
Fiora.teamfight: If hit by Fiora R Grand Challenge, stand against a wall so you don’t expose all four vitals. After an ally lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to split the enemy formation, then lock down a target with Irelia E Flawless Duet and engage with Irelia Q Bladesurge.

Galio.watch: When Galio W Shield of Durand starts charging, walk out of taunt range. Avoid the point where both gusts overlap from Galio Q Winds of War, and dodge Galio E Justice Punch when you see him step back to wind it up.
Galio.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Galio’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots, and prioritize magic resistance.
Galio.fight: Don’t commit your damage while Galio W Shield of Durand is charging. Use Irelia E Flawless Duet to interrupt Galio when he retaliates or tries to escape.
Galio.laning: Make Galio use his abilities to clear the wave, then push the lane while his mana is low. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge only on minions you can finish to reset its cooldown and keep an escape route open.
Galio.escape: Look for an opening after Galio E Justice Punch is down and before Galio R Hero’s Entrance is available again. Close the gap by finishing low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge, then lock him down with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Before engaging, also check that the minion wave leaves you a way out.
Galio.teamfight: When the landing area for Galio R Hero’s Entrance appears, immediately walk out of range. After your ally lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the enemy team, lock down a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then use Irelia Q Bladesurge to dive into the backline.
Galio.phase: You get stronger as you build items, but avoid forcing engages and falling behind in your growth.

Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg gets more dangerous as it ages, so back away when an aged keg is nearby and don’t enter the area where two kegs overlap. Gangplank W Remove Scurvy removes stuns and restores health, so when looking for a kill, check whether he has used W before casting Irelia E Flawless Duet.
Gangplank.build: If Gangplank Q Parrrley keeps harassing you, prioritize armor from the laning phase. Resistance does not mitigate the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire or Gangplank R Cannon Barrage, so build health too. If his healing keeps negating short trades, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Gangplank.fight: Right after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, build up Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks in advance, then go in briefly to trade. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, lock him down with Irelia E Flawless Duet and follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Gangplank.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to reset it and keep an escape route open, and back away from aged Gangplank E Powder Kegs.
Gangplank.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance. Use Q, reset by the E mark, to chase.
Gangplank.escape: Engage right after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, before it ages. Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge, but land Irelia E Flawless Duet after Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down.
Gangplank.teamfight: After your ally lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to block Gangplank’s escape route. Check whether Gangplank W Remove Scurvy has been used, then lock him down with Irelia E Flawless Duet and follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge, which resets on the mark.

Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike empowers his basic attack and silences you, so don’t approach while it is active. When Garen E Judgment starts spinning, don’t stay in the fight for long; move out of range. If your health is below half, stay out of range of Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on your missing health.
Garen.build: Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment. Garen R Demacian Justice cannot be reduced by resistance, so check your total health when gauging whether you can withstand its damage. If Garen P Perseverance’s healing keeps negating short trades, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Garen.fight: Build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks in advance and repeat short trades where you go in and back out. Start fights right after the empowered basic attack from Garen Q Decisive Strike is used on a minion or otherwise spent, and don’t stay close for long while Garen E Judgment is spinning. Use Irelia E Flawless Duet to interrupt Garen when he retaliates or escapes, but avoid the moment right after Garen W Courage, when its shield and tenacity are active.
Garen.laning: Push or pressure the lane from the early game to limit Garen’s chances to build permanent stacks on Garen W Courage. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to reset its cooldown and keep an escape route open.
Garen.combo: Then land basic attacks and use Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Garen.escape: Garen has no mobility ability to create distance, so engage after he has used the silence from Garen Q Decisive Strike. Before going in, check the positions of low-health minions so you have a minion to dash to for an escape after entering with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Don’t stay in the spin of Garen E Judgment for long, and if your health is below half, don’t enter range of Garen R Demacian Justice.
Garen.phase: Irelia gets stronger as she completes more items, but Garen also gets stronger as he gains permanent stacks on Garen W Courage. Pressure Garen early and don’t rack up deaths by forcing bad engages.
Garen.teamfight: After your ally lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the enemy team, including Garen. Place the blade wall in a direction that blocks their escape route, lock down a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then use Irelia Q Bladesurge in succession. Don’t rush to stun right after Garen W Courage, and if health has decreased, move out of range of Garen R Demacian Justice.

Gwen.watch: The center of the cone from Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage, so move to the side when she casts it to avoid the center. Gwen inside Gwen W Hallowed Mist cannot be targeted from outside the mist, so enter it or wait for it to end. Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework deal damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stay close for long.
Gwen.build: Withstand the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance against Gwen’s main damage, but avoid the center true damage of Gwen Q Snip Snip! by changing your position. Gwen has high armor, so consider penetration when increasing your damage. If her healing keeps negating short trades, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Gwen.fight: Fill Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks by hitting minions with abilities, then go in briefly and back out. Look for trades before Gwen Q Snip Snip! reaches full stacks, and move out of her range after trading so she can’t heal with basic attacks. Right after baiting out Gwen E Skip ’n Slash, lock her down with Irelia E Flawless Duet and follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Gwen.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge only on minions you can finish to reset its cooldown and keep an escape route open. Gwen E Skip ’n Slash can come back quickly around many minions, so check the wave position before choosing where to fight.
Gwen.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Gwen.escape: Look for an opening right after Gwen uses Gwen E Skip ’n Slash. Stun her with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge. First check for low-health minions and whether Irelia Q Bladesurge can reset, so you can use them to escape.
Gwen.phase: Later on, Irelia gets stronger as she builds more items, but repeatedly dying by forcing engages will stall your growth.
Gwen.teamfight: After your ally lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split Gwen’s side of the enemy team and block their escape route. Lock down a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge in succession. Avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance to reduce damage when her abilities hit.

Gnar.watch: The boomerang from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss can hit on both the outward and return paths, so move out of its path. Mega Gnar R GNAR! stuns targets it knocks into a wall, so don’t fight with your back to a wall. Avoid direct fights when his Rage is filling up and transformation is near.
Gnar.build: Build armor first against Gnar’s main physical damage. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so armor or health alone won’t block all his damage. Consider tenacity when Mega Gnar’s wall stun is a concern.
Gnar.fight: Right after Mini Gnar uses Gnar E Hop / Crunch, fill Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks, close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, and stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Immediately after he transforms into Mega Gnar, create distance and wait it out.
Gnar.laning: If Mini Gnar’s ranged harassment leaves no opening to engage, farm and scale near your turret. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge only to finish low-health minions and keep its reset available; watch for minion paths you can use to engage or retreat. Don’t expose yourself to ganks by using Irelia E Flawless Duet recklessly.
Gnar.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance. Using Irelia Q Bladesurge on a marked Gnar resets its cooldown, letting you keep on him.
Gnar.escape: The window to engage is right after Mini Gnar’s only mobility tool, Gnar E Hop / Crunch, has been spent. Close the distance with Irelia Q Bladesurge and stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet, making it hard for him to escape. Against Mega Gnar, avoid wall stuns and engage just after he reverts to Mini Gnar, while he can’t transform again.
Gnar.phase: From the mid game onward, Irelia gets stronger as she builds more items. While Mega Gnar is out, create distance and look to engage just after he reverts to Mini Gnar.
Gnar.teamfight: Avoid fighting with your back to a wall or in narrow terrain to avoid Gnar R GNAR!’s wall stun. Start a team fight just after Mega Gnar reverts to Mini Gnar, while he can’t transform again. If your team’s crowd control lands first, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to cut off Gnar’s escape route, then lock him down with Irelia E Flawless Duet before engaging with Irelia Q Bladesurge.

Illaoi.watch: If Illaoi E Test of Spirit hits you, it pulls out your spirit, so stay out of range and dodge it while last-hitting. Illaoi R Leap of Faith greatly increases her damage for a short time, so back off and wait out its duration. Don’t fight near walls covered in tentacles.
Illaoi.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, Q Tentacle Smash, and W Harsh Lesson. If healing makes short trades ineffective, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a large amount of health.
Illaoi.fight: Build stacks of Irelia P Ionian Fervor on minions in advance, then make short trades by engaging and disengaging. Just after baiting Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge and stun her with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Don’t keep fighting while Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active; disengage.
Illaoi.laning: Keep the wave away from walls, and last-hit from outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit’s range. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to secure its reset and a path to move. Before engaging, check that there’s a minion you can use to escape too.
Illaoi.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge and use basic attacks, then use the Q reset from the mark again before the stun wears off. Reduce damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance when she retaliates.
Illaoi.escape: Your chance to engage comes just after dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit and baiting her into using W Harsh Lesson. Close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge and stun her with E Flawless Duet. If Illaoi uses R Leap of Faith, escape along the chain of minions you saved for Q.
Illaoi.phase: Irelia gets stronger as she gains items, but don’t force your way into Illaoi’s tentacles and ultimate.
Illaoi.teamfight: Avoid areas near walls covered in Illaoi’s tentacles and draw her into open ground if possible. Spread out so multiple allies aren’t hit by Illaoi R Leap of Faith, then wait out its short duration after she uses it. If your team’s crowd control lands first, split the formation with Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, then engage with E Flawless Duet and Q Bladesurge.

Hwei.watch: If Hwei E Subject: Torment roots or displaces you, you’re likely to take follow-up damage. If the first spell hits, move immediately to avoid the second spell and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster can deal damage based on your maximum health, so leave its marked area.
Hwei.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Hwei’s main damage is magic, and Irelia has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Hwei.fight: Look for an opening just after Hwei uses E Subject: Torment to harass or clear the wave. Hit minions with abilities to build stacks of Irelia P Ionian Fervor, stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge and follow up with basic attacks. While Hwei E Subject: Torment is available, your engage can be pushed back or rooted.
Hwei.laning: Check the wave position and Irelia Q Bladesurge resets from killing minions so you have a route to engage or retreat. Wasting Irelia E Flawless Duet when there’s no opening to trade leaves you vulnerable to ganks.
Hwei.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Hwei.escape: When Hwei E Subject: Torment is on cooldown, that’s your chance to go in. Hwei has no mobility, so close the distance with Irelia Q Bladesurge and catch him with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Before engaging, check the wave position so you can use minions to escape.
Hwei.teamfight: After your team’s crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split Hwei’s formation and cut off his escape route. While Hwei E Subject: Torment is on cooldown, catch your target with Irelia E Flawless Duet and dive into the backline with a chain of Irelia Q Bladesurge resets. Avoid engaging through passages containing Hwei’s ground effects or an eye he has placed.
Hwei.phase: Irelia gets stronger as she builds items, but avoid forcing engages and falling behind in her growth.

Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, basic attacks are dodged, and its reactivation damage increases with each attack dodged.
Jax.build: Jax’s basic attacks and attack speed are the core of his damage, so prioritize ways to reduce his attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so consider both armor and magic resistance.
Jax.fight: Hit minions with abilities to build stacks of Irelia P Ionian Fervor in advance, then make short trades. When Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop basic attacking and create distance; after it ends, catch him with Irelia E Flawless Duet and engage again.
Jax.laning: Avoid a level 1 melee trade, where Jax has the advantage, and build a lead in CS and levels from level 2 onward. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to keep a means of moving around.
Jax.combo: Then dash to marked Jax with Irelia Q Bladesurge, followed by basic attacks and Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Jax.escape: Right after Jax uses Q Leap Strike, take advantage of his lost mobility: close the distance with Irelia Q Bladesurge and catch him with Irelia E Flawless Duet. If Jax E Counter Strike is active, don’t engage; move outside its stun range. When retreating, finish low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge to keep moving.
Jax.teamfight: When Jax activates E Counter Strike and engages, don’t group up nearby; avoid its area stun. Just after the stun ends, catch him with Irelia E Flawless Duet. After your team’s crowd control lands first, split the enemy formation with Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and engage.

Jayce.watch: When Jayce is in cannon form and places Jayce E Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q Shock Blast may be coming, so sidestep out of its line. In hammer form, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow.
Jayce.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Jayce W Lightning Field / Hyper Charge and Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate. Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast deals physical damage, which magic resistance cannot block, so dodge it.
Jayce.fight: Before trading, hit minions with abilities to stack Irelia P Ionian Fervor. Once the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, bind him with Irelia E Flawless Duet and engage.
Jayce.laning: Don't force your way onto ranged Jayce. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to reset its cooldown and secure CS. Move side to side to watch for Jayce Q Shock Blast, and if health has decreased, clear the wave and come back. Keep Irelia Q Bladesurge available, and track which minions you can use to engage or retreat.
Jayce.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Jayce.escape: The moment Jayce Q To the Skies! is down is your chance to close the gap. In hammer form, once you confirm Jayce E Thundering Blow's knockback is also used, stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet and engage. When you need to retreat, finish a low-health minion with Irelia Q Bladesurge to keep moving.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so farm defensively instead of forcing a comeback. You grow stronger as you acquire items in the mid game and beyond, but the available information isn't enough to determine who has the advantage late.
Jayce.teamfight: Engage after your team's crowd control lands. Block Jayce's escape route with Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, bind him with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then follow up with a chain of marked Irelia Q Bladesurge casts. If you close in after forcing Jayce Q To the Skies! to be used, you can target Jayce without an escape.

KSante.watch: If you've been hit by K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes in succession, or K'Sante has stacked it by hitting minions, watch for the pull and stun on his next Q. While K'Sante W Path Maker is charging, it grants unstoppable status and damage reduction, so don't use Irelia E Flawless Duet; sidestep the direction of his dash. When facing off, also check the terrain behind you so K'Sante R All Out can't knock you over a wall.
KSante.build: Add physical armor penetration to deal with K'Sante's high armor. If you build resistance, choose armor over magic resistance, but keep in mind that resistance cannot reduce the true damage from K'Sante W Path Maker.
KSante.fight: Build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks in advance and repeat short trades where you go in and back out. Don't commit your damage while K'Sante W Path Maker is charging; dodge the dash, then use Irelia E Flawless Duet to stop his counterattack or escape. When K'Sante R All Out is active, K'Sante becomes briefly more vulnerable, so focus your damage, but don't try to withstand his increased damage and lifesteal alone.
KSante.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to reset its cooldown and preserve a route to move through.
KSante.combo: Then go in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance. E's mark resets Q's cooldown, so you can follow K'Sante with Q when he creates distance again.
KSante.escape: The chance to engage comes after K'Sante has used both K'Sante W Path Maker and K'Sante E Footwork. If only one is down, he can escape with the other movement ability, so wait and look for an opening before K'Sante R All Out is back up. Then close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge and stop his escape with Irelia E Flawless Duet.
KSante.phase: Irelia grows stronger as she acquires items, but once K'Sante has built up defensive items, it becomes difficult to turn the lane around, so don't lose your growth by forcing an engage.
KSante.teamfight: Engage after your team's crowd control lands. Block K'Sante's escape route with Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, then go in with Irelia E Flawless Duet and Irelia Q Bladesurge. While K'Sante W Path Maker is charging, hold your stun and damage, and dodge the dash. If you plan to fight for a long time while K'Sante R All Out is active, make sure at least one member of your team has a way to apply Grievous Wounds, and don't let K'Sante keep hitting multiple people.

Kassadin.watch: Kassadin E Force Pulse slows you, and it comes back faster the more abilities are used near Kassadin. Avoid unnecessary ability casts, and reduce the damage from Kassadin R Riftwalk with Irelia W Defiant Dance when he dives in.
Kassadin.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to survive the early game. Kassadin deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Kassadin.fight: When Kassadin counters or retreats, stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge when he is marked or when there's a minion you can finish.
Kassadin.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to keep resetting its cooldown, and watch the positions of minions you can use to engage or retreat.
Kassadin.combo: When Kassadin is marked, dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, then follow up with Irelia W Defiant Dance. You can chase Kassadin again with the reset Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Kassadin.escape: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on a minion you can finish to close the gap, then stun Kassadin with Irelia E Flawless Duet. If Kassadin has used Kassadin R Riftwalk repeatedly, check his mana and counterattack when he no longer has enough mana to move.
Kassadin.phase: In the late game, Kassadin repeatedly dives in and disengages, so don't stand alone within Kassadin R Riftwalk's range.
Kassadin.teamfight: Engage after your team's crowd control lands, and block Kassadin's escape route with Irelia R Vanguard's Edge. Bind him with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then follow up with a chain of marked Irelia Q Bladesurge casts. If Kassadin dives into your backline, reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance.

Karma.watch: The area slow from Karma Q Inner Flame is dangerous. If an empowered Karma R Mantra Q leaves a zone, walk out before it detonates again. If Karma W Focused Resolve tethers you, create distance and break the tether before it roots you. Repeatedly taking poke reduces Karma R Mantra's cooldown, so reposition behind minions or outside her range.
Karma.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Karma's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If healing from Karma's empowered Karma R Mantra W keeps negating your short trades, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Karma.fight: Just before a trade, hit minions with abilities to stack Irelia P Ionian Fervor. Once Karma W Focused Resolve is down and Karma E Inspire's shield has ended, use Irelia Q Bladesurge on a minion you can finish to close the gap, then stun her with Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you have to take Karma's abilities, reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Karma.laning: Early on, don't force your way in. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge only on low-health minions to reset its cooldown and secure CS. Stand behind minions or outside her range so you don't take free hits from Karma Q Inner Flame. Check the minion positions you can use to engage and retreat, and avoid wasting Irelia E Flawless Duet on a forced trade and leaving yourself vulnerable to ganks.
Karma.combo: When Karma is marked, dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance. Q resets when it hits a marked target, so you can follow up with another Q.
Karma.escape: Your chance to engage comes after Karma uses Karma W Focused Resolve or you break its tether. Wait until Karma E Inspire's shield and movement speed boost have ended, then approach with a chain of Irelia Q Bladesurge casts through minions and land Irelia E Flawless Duet. If Karma W Focused Resolve is available, diving in first can let her root you and stop your engage.
Karma.phase: You grow stronger as you acquire items, but dying on a forced engage costs you your growth momentum.
Karma.teamfight: Delay your engage if Karma W Focused Resolve is available or Karma has just applied the area shield from empowered Karma R Mantra E. After your team's crowd control lands, split the enemy formation with Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, stun a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then dive into the backline with a chain of Irelia Q Bladesurge casts. If Karma tethers you with W, create distance and break the tether before it roots you.

Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast slows and reduces armor and magic resistance, so dodge the direct hit. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals more damage based on your missing health, so don’t extend trades when your health is low. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don’t pour out damage; bind her with Irelia E Flawless Duet and wait out the invulnerability.
Kayle.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Kayle’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance, but you need to dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast to get value from it. If Kayle W Celestial Blessing’s healing keeps negating short trades, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Kayle.fight: If Kayle R Divine Judgment is still available, account for it before committing all your damage at once.
Kayle.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to keep its reset, and check the wave position both when engaging and retreating. Kayle is vulnerable to ganks, so call your jungler and bind her with Irelia E Flawless Duet before dealing damage.
Kayle.combo: Use Irelia W Defiant Dance when Kayle retaliates to reduce the damage.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility ability, but Kayle W Celestial Blessing can increase her movement speed and Kayle Q Radiant Blast can slow you. If you dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast or she has used Kayle W Celestial Blessing, block her escape route with Irelia E Flawless Duet and close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Kayle.teamfight: Find a path to reach Kayle directly from the flank or outside her vision, and engage after your allies apply crowd control. Use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to cut off Kayle’s escape route and split the enemy formation, then bind her with Irelia E Flawless Duet and follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge.

Kennen.watch: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken hits only the first target, so dodge it by standing behind minions. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm has stacked twice, back off to avoid the third hit and stun. In team fights, watch out for the area stun from Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom and spread out from your allies.
Kennen.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Kennen’s damage is mainly magic, and Irelia has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize building magic resistance.
Kennen.fight: Once Kennen E Lightning Rush is down and you’ve managed Kennen P Mark of the Storm stacks, use minions to set up a chain of Irelia Q Bladesurge dashes and engage. Before going in, hit minions with abilities to build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks.
Kennen.laning: Don’t force an engage on ranged Kennen; farm while dodging Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge only on minions you can last-hit to preserve its reset and your movement path. Wasting Irelia E Flawless Duet leaves you vulnerable to ganks, so save it when there’s no opening to engage.
Kennen.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge and land basic attacks, followed by Irelia W Defiant Dance. The mark from Irelia E Flawless Duet resets Irelia Q Bladesurge’s cooldown, letting you follow up again.
Kennen.escape: Engage when Kennen E Lightning Rush is down and there’s no risk of being stunned by Kennen P Mark of the Storm. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm has stacked twice, back off first and wait for the stacks to disappear. When you need to retreat, chain Irelia Q Bladesurge through low-health minions.
Kennen.phase: From the mid game onward, don’t keep forcing engages, and watch out for the area stun from Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom.
Kennen.teamfight: Expect Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom to hit the center of your team and spread out; use vision to cover his entry point. If Kennen engages, reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance, then engage after your allies apply crowd control. Use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to block Kennen’s escape route, bind him with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge.

Kled.watch: If you’re caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, use Irelia Q Bladesurge to create distance before you’re pulled in. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, back off to avoid the fourth basic attack, then re-engage. Use flank vision to spot Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! starting from out of sight.
Kled.build: Build armor first to prepare for the physical damage from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, W Violent Tendencies, and E Jousting. Kled W Violent Tendencies and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying heavily on health alone.
Kled.fight: Build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks by hitting minions with abilities, then engage and disengage with short trades. Avoid Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth basic attack; when he retaliates, interrupt him with Irelia E Flawless Duet or reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Kled.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to keep its reset, and check the wave both when engaging and retreating. If you’ve dismounted Kled, watch his Courage bar; if you can’t kill him, create distance and pressure him so he can’t farm minions.
Kled.combo: You can follow up again with Irelia Q Bladesurge, reset by the mark, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance when Kled retaliates.
Kled.escape: Engage after Kled E Jousting is down and before Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes back up. Close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge, then bind him with Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you’re caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, use Irelia Q Bladesurge to escape before you’re pulled in.
Kled.phase: Kled becomes much weaker after the laning phase and mid game, so don’t give him an early lead and play for the long game.
Kled.teamfight: Use flank vision to spot Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! coming in and hold your formation. After your allies apply crowd control, split the enemy formation with Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, then follow up on the target bound by Irelia E Flawless Duet with Irelia Q Bladesurge.

Leblanc.watch: If LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice marks you, the next ability deals increased damage, so don’t move forward. Back away until the mark disappears. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, use Irelia Q Bladesurge to get out of chain range before the root applies. If LeBlanc P Mirror Image creates a clone, don’t rush your abilities; identify which one is real by seeing which one attacks.
Leblanc.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. LeBlanc deals mostly magic damage, and Irelia has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. If the root keeps you from continuing your attacks right after engaging, prepare a Quicksilver Sash.
Leblanc.fight: Build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks by hitting minions with abilities. Once LeBlanc W Distortion’s return expires or is used, stun her with Irelia E Flawless Duet and close in. Don’t engage by using Irelia Q Bladesurge first on an unmarked LeBlanc.
Leblanc.laning: Rather than forcing an engage on ranged LeBlanc, farm and grow by using Irelia Q Bladesurge only to finish low-health minions. Preserve your Q resets and watch for minion positions you can use to escape. If LeBlanc disappears from vision, alert your team immediately. Before pushing a side lane, secure river vision.
Leblanc.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance. The mark from E resets Q’s cooldown, so you can use Q again before the stun ends.
Leblanc.escape: The moment after you make LeBlanc use W Distortion is your chance to close the gap. Once the time for LeBlanc to return to her original position has passed, or after she has already used her return, stun her with Irelia E Flawless Duet and follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, prioritize using Q to get out of chain range before the root applies.
Leblanc.phase: From the mid game onward, bait LeBlanc into using her abilities first, then reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance. Take advantage of Irelia’s scaling as she gets more items.
Leblanc.teamfight: After your team lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the enemy formation, including LeBlanc. Stun a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then use marked Irelia Q Bladesurge resets to reach the back line. If the enemy engages first, reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance, then counterattack.

Malphite.watch: If Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you, its slow makes it hard to engage or retreat, so don’t start a trade right after being hit. Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash that knocks up multiple enemies, and Irelia E Flawless Duet cannot interrupt it. When Malphite is out of sight, watch bushes and the areas behind walls, and spread out from your allies.
Malphite.build: Early on, withstand his damage with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. Malphite’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Against Malphite’s high armor, it’s better to respond with percent max-health damage or magic damage.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks, then go in briefly and back out. If Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you, don’t start a trade while slowed. Save Irelia E Flawless Duet for when Malphite counterattacks or retreats.
Malphite.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge and land basic attacks. Use Irelia W Defiant Dance when Malphite counterattacks. If you hit the mark from Irelia E Flawless Duet with Irelia Q Bladesurge to reset its cooldown, you can follow up again.
Malphite.escape: Stun Malphite with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Check your minion escape route in advance, and don’t engage right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you.
Malphite.laning: Before Malphite learns Malphite R Unstoppable Force, take control of the lane and draw jungle ganks to slow his growth. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to reset its cooldown and secure a path to move.
Malphite.teamfight: Space out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force doesn't knock up multiple people, and counterattack as soon as it's down. If your team lands crowd control first, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to split the enemy formation and block their escape route. Lock down a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then follow them to the back line with Irelia Q Bladesurge.

Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding roots you, you’re likely to be hit by her follow-up abilities in quick succession, so bait it out and dodge it first. Leave the area where Lux E Lucent Singularity is placed. When your health is low, sidestep if you see the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark. If Lux’s ability hits you, keep your distance so you don’t also take a basic attack that triggers Lux P Illumination.
Lux.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. Lux deals mostly magic damage, and Irelia has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Lux.fight: After dodging Lux Q Light Binding, close the gap by chaining Irelia Q Bladesurge through minions, then stun her with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Before engaging, hit minions with abilities to build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks.
Lux.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Lux.escape: Engage the moment Lux Q Light Binding misses. Lux has no ability to create distance on her own, so close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge, then catch her with Irelia E Flawless Duet.
Lux.phase: From the mid game onward, Irelia gets stronger as she gains items, but choose your timing carefully and wait until Lux Q Light Binding is on cooldown to avoid dying in a forced engage.
Lux.teamfight: Approach from different directions, spread out from your allies so Lux E Lucent Singularity doesn’t stop you all at once. After your team lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to block Lux’s escape route, then catch her with Irelia E Flawless Duet and follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge. After engaging, reduce incoming damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance when the enemy uses their abilities.
