Lux.laning: Against ranged Lux, don't force your way in. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge only on low-health minions you can finish to secure CS and a path to move. Lux Q Light Binding roots up to the first two enemies it hits, so don't stand in a line with your allies. Check the minion positions you'll use to engage and retreat, and don't waste Irelia E Flawless Duet on a forced engage.

Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting a minion, so don’t stand in a straight line with allied minions. You can take damage while rooted by Lissandra W Ring of Frost or stunned by Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, so check whether each of the two abilities has been used before engaging. If Lissandra uses R Frozen Tomb on herself, she avoids damage with its immunity, so continue attacking after the stasis ends.
Lissandra.build: Early on, withstand her damage with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. Lissandra deals mostly magic damage, and Irelia has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Lissandra’s healing keeps negating your short trades, fit an Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Lissandra.fight: Go for a short trade right after Lissandra uses W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it. Before fighting, hit minions with abilities to build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks. Stun her with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge and follow up with empowered basic attacks.
Lissandra.laning: Farm at an angle to allied minions so you can avoid the path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard as it pierces. If there’s no opening to engage, use Irelia Q Bladesurge only on low-health minions you can finish to preserve your resets and farm safely. If you waste Irelia E Flawless Duet trying to force an engage, you’ll be vulnerable to ganks.
Lissandra.combo: Then land basic attacks and use Irelia W Defiant Dance. The mark from Irelia E Flawless Duet resets Irelia Q Bladesurge’s cooldown, letting you follow up repeatedly.
Lissandra.escape: The moment after Lissandra uses E Glacial Path is your chance to close the gap. If W Ring of Frost is also on cooldown, engage and trade. While the claw from Lissandra E Glacial Path is traveling, stun her with Irelia E Flawless Duet to prevent her from recasting it to travel. Before engaging, also check the minion positions you can dash to with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Lissandra.phase: In the mid and late game, don’t keep forcing engages. Check whether Lissandra has used her crowd control and mobility abilities.
Lissandra.teamfight: After your team lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the enemy formation and block their escape route. If Lissandra E Glacial Path is on cooldown, catch her with Irelia E Flawless Duet and follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is still available, don’t use all your finishing damage at once; continue your attack after the stasis ends.

Mordekaiser.watch: Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates after he hits you with three attacks or abilities, dealing damage over time and granting him movement speed. Trade once or twice, then back off. If the aura activates, don’t stay close for long. When Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don’t enter its range alone.
Mordekaiser.build: Mordekaiser’s main damage is magic, and Irelia has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. If Mordekaiser W Indestructible keeps negating your short trades with its healing, fit Executioner’s Calling in between core items.
Mordekaiser.fight: Build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks first, then repeat short trades where you engage and back off. Dodge Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp, then stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet and close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Don’t commit your damage right after Mordekaiser W Indestructible grants its shield; wait until it wears down or converts into healing.
Mordekaiser.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to reset its cooldown and preserve a route to move through. Spread out from your allies when facing Mordekaiser so Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp doesn’t pull you in together.
Mordekaiser.combo: If Mordekaiser retaliates, reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Mordekaiser.escape: The opening to engage comes after Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp is down. Mordekaiser has no skill to create distance, so pin him with Irelia E Flawless Duet and close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge. When you need to retreat, finish low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge and chain through them.
Mordekaiser.phase: In the mid and late game, don’t force an engage from a position where Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can trap you alone.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: After your allies land crowd control, split the enemy formation with Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, then follow up with Irelia E Flawless Duet and Irelia Q Bladesurge to dive into the backline. Keep your distance so Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp can’t pull in several allies at once. If Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, avoid engaging alone within its range.

Malzahar.watch: When a minion afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect transfers to a nearby enemy, so don’t wait for a last hit beside that minion. If you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void being cast, delay your engage and move beyond the outer edges of both portals to avoid the silence. Malzahar R Nether Grasp can’t be escaped with Irelia Q Bladesurge, so don’t enter an area without vision alone while Malzahar can use R.
Malzahar.build: Malzahar’s main damage is magic, and Irelia has low magic resistance, so start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. Consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to counter Malzahar R Nether Grasp. R deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on simply stacking health.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, break it first with Irelia E Flawless Duet. When Void Shift is down, stun him and close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Malzahar W Void Swarm summons are already out, clear them with Irelia W Defiant Dance before fighting.
Malzahar.laning: Rather than forcing an approach onto ranged Malzahar, use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to keep its resets and secure CS. Stay away from minions afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions, and pressure Malzahar with your jungler when he pushes the lane. If an opportunity to pressure him comes up early, deny him time to build Malzahar W Void Swarm growth stacks.
Malzahar.combo: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, break it first with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then start your engage combo when Void Shift is down. Hitting Malzahar with Q while he has E’s mark resets Q’s cooldown, letting you keep chasing with consecutive casts.
Malzahar.escape: Malzahar has no skill to create distance, so avoiding the silence from Malzahar Q Call of the Void and breaking Malzahar P Void Shift create an opportunity to engage. When Malzahar W Void Swarm summons are gone or haven’t appeared yet, close the gap by dashing to a low-health minion with Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Malzahar can use R Nether Grasp, don’t engage alone in an area without vision.
Malzahar.phase: Irelia also gets stronger as items come in, but you’ll be at a growing disadvantage if Malzahar builds up Malzahar W Void Swarm growth stacks. Play safely and scale early while looking for chances to pressure him with your jungler; don’t lose your growth by forcing an engage.
Malzahar.teamfight: If Malzahar W Void Swarm summons are on the field, clear them first with Irelia W Defiant Dance before engaging. After your allies land crowd control, split the enemy formation and escape routes with Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, then pin your target with Irelia E Flawless Duet and keep chasing with chained casts of Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Malzahar R Nether Grasp suppresses you, break free with Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar, or have an ally interrupt the cast with immobilizing crowd control on Malzahar.

Naafiri.watch: If you’re hit by Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers once and afflicted with its bleed, create distance to dodge the second Q. Naafiri E Eviscerate revives her pack, so look for a chance to clear the pack with Irelia W Defiant Dance right after she uses it. You can’t target Naafiri while Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, so use your abilities after it ends.
Naafiri.build: Naafiri deals physical damage, so build armor first and get health as well. If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and E Eviscerate healing keep negating your short trades, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Naafiri.fight: Build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks first, then repeat short trades where you engage and back off. Clear the pack right after Naafiri uses E Eviscerate, and close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge before Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit comes back up, then pin her with E Flawless Duet. If Naafiri dives in first, reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Naafiri.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to reset its cooldown and preserve a route to move through. If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you the first time, back off until the bleed ends.
Naafiri.combo: Use Q resets from E’s mark to chase again before the stun wears off. Activate Irelia W Defiant Dance when Naafiri retaliates.
Naafiri.escape: Don’t engage as soon as just one of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers or E Eviscerate is down. She can escape by chaining several movement abilities, so especially look to approach with Irelia Q Bladesurge and pin her with E Flawless Duet before Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit comes back up.
Naafiri.phase: In the mid game, Naafiri’s roams are the biggest threat, so maintain wide vision and don’t get caught alone. In the late game, group up and start a front-to-front team fight; Naafiri’s pack will be swept away by area damage, reducing her damage.
Naafiri.teamfight: After your allies land crowd control, block Naafiri’s escape route with Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, pin her with E Flawless Duet, and chase with Q Bladesurge. Don’t roam alone if Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit is ready. Right after an ally dies, Naafiri can use R again, so retreat immediately to avoid getting picked off in succession.

Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither slows both movement and attack speed, so don’t continue trading basic attacks while affected by it. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, it grants health and defensive stats, so avoid fighting and let it run out unless you have a clear advantage in numbers and damage.
Nasus.build: Build armor first to counter the damage from Nasus’s main ability, Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces your armor, so don’t stay in its area. Also account for the fact that Nasus R Fury of the Sands deals damage based on your maximum health.
Nasus.fight: Use Irelia E Flawless Duet to stun Nasus when he retaliates or retreats. If you’re hit by Nasus W Wither, don’t force a basic attack trade.
Nasus.laning: Don’t keep pushing the lane under Nasus’s tower, where he can comfortably stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Let the lane come to you while pressuring him off last hits, and call your jungler to gank Nasus, whose only escape is Flash.
Nasus.combo: Make use of Irelia Q Bladesurge resets from marks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance to absorb Nasus’s retaliation.
Nasus.escape: Engage after Nasus W Wither is down to reduce the risk of getting slowed and losing a basic attack trade. Check the positions of low-health minions before going in so you can also use Irelia Q Bladesurge resets to retreat.
Nasus.phase: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike stacks are permanent, making him harder to deal with as time goes on, so deny him chances to stack from the early game.
Nasus.teamfight: When health is full, don’t take Nasus head-on; keep your distance and let Nasus R Fury of the Sands run out. After your allies land crowd control, split the formation with Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, then engage with chained casts of Irelia E Flawless Duet and Irelia Q Bladesurge.

Mel.watch: If Mel E Solar Snare hits you at its center, it roots you and Mel Q Radiant Volley follows, so dodge sideways. Mel W Rebuttal can reflect projectiles, so it’s better to bait it with basic attacks before using Irelia E Flawless Duet. If Mel has hit you several times, watch out for the execute from Mel P Searing Brilliance even if you still have health. After a fight, Mel R Golden Eclipse can still reach you, so wait somewhere safe until the stacks on you disappear.
Mel.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Mel deals mostly magic damage, and Irelia has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Mel.fight: Once Mel E Solar Snare is down and Mel W Rebuttal has been used, stun her with Irelia E Flawless Duet and close the distance with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Before fighting, hit minions with abilities to build stacks of Irelia P Ionian Fervor, then follow up with basic attacks.
Mel.laning: Rather than forcing your way onto ranged Mel, last-hit low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge to reset its cooldown and collect CS. Check the minion positions you can use to engage and retreat, and don’t use Irelia Q Bladesurge first on Mel when she has no mark. When you can pressure her early, push the wave to give her less time to build stacks.
Mel.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge and land basic attacks, using the mark’s reset to follow up again with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Use Irelia W Defiant Dance when Mel fights back or you are ganked.
Mel.escape: The opening to engage comes after Mel E Solar Snare is down and Mel W Rebuttal has been used. If Mel E Solar Snare roots you, watch for the Mel Q Radiant Volley that follows. When retreating, use Irelia Q Bladesurge on a minion you can finish to dash away in succession.
Mel.phase: As you build items in the mid game, Irelia also gets stronger, so avoid losing your growth through reckless engages. Mel’s growth from Mel R Golden Eclipse remains as the game goes late, putting you at a disadvantage, so pressure her from early on.
Mel.teamfight: After your allies land crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to block Mel’s escape route and split the enemy team. Lock down a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then use Irelia Q Bladesurge to dive into the back line. If the enemy uses abilities first, hold your ground while reducing the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up if it hits something first, so don’t stand directly behind or overlap with minions or allies. If Neeko approaches while disguised, you may not see the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom, so back away as soon as a suspicious enemy gets close. Don’t chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; watch the real Neeko’s position.
Neeko.build: Early on, withstand Neeko’s magic damage with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs roots you and Neeko R Pop Blossom can follow, prioritize tenacity.
Neeko.fight: Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down is a good window to trade. Before fighting, hit minions with abilities to build stacks of Irelia P Ionian Fervor, then stun Neeko with Irelia E Flawless Duet, close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, and follow up with basic attacks. Don’t engage by using Irelia Q Bladesurge first on Neeko when she has no mark.
Neeko.laning: Against ranged Neeko, grow by last-hitting low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge instead of forcing your way onto her. Watch the wave so you can keep resetting Q, and leave a minion to escape to if Neeko closes in. Avoid forcing an engage right after wasting Irelia E Flawless Duet, when you’re vulnerable to ganks.
Neeko.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance. Hitting Neeko with Q while she has E’s mark resets its cooldown, letting you follow up again with Q.
Neeko.escape: Close the distance with Irelia Q Bladesurge and stun Neeko with Irelia E Flawless Duet, but first check the minion positions you can use to escape.
Neeko.phase: As you build items from mid game onward, Irelia gets stronger, so don’t lose your growth through reckless engages. In late-game team fights, also watch for Neeko engaging while disguised.
Neeko.teamfight: After your allies land crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to block Neeko’s escape route and stun her with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Then follow the marked target with Irelia Q Bladesurge.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns you, so be careful not to give him range. Stand behind minions when avoiding Pantheon Q Comet Spear. When Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, wait before attacking him from the front or angle in from the side.
Pantheon.build: Build armor first to prepare for Pantheon’s main damage.
Pantheon.fight: Interrupt Pantheon with Irelia E Flawless Duet when he fights back or retreats. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, don’t unload attacks into him from the front.
Pantheon.laning: Stand behind minions to avoid Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to reset its cooldown and secure an escape route, and don’t engage by using it first on Pantheon when he has no mark.
Pantheon.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge, reset by the mark, to chase.
Pantheon.escape: The opening to engage comes after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back up. At that point, close the distance by dashing to minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge, then stun Pantheon with Irelia E Flawless Duet so he can’t escape.
Pantheon.phase: As you build items, Irelia gets stronger and Pantheon’s influence fades, so don’t lose your growth through reckless engages.
Pantheon.teamfight: After your allies land crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to split the enemy formation around Pantheon. Stun a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet and chain Irelia Q Bladesurge onto the mark, but be careful not to approach Pantheon first while he can use Pantheon W Shield Vault.

Poppy.fight: Hit minions with abilities to build stacks of Irelia P Ionian Fervor, then make short trades by going in and backing out. Once Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, stun her with Irelia E Flawless Duet and engage with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Even if Poppy looks low on health, account for her increased armor and only dive deep when you’re sure you can finish her.
Poppy.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to reset its cooldown and secure an escape route. When the shield thrown by Poppy P Iron Ambassador lands, step on it first to deny her shield, but don’t follow it toward a position with a wall behind you.
Poppy.escape: Right after you make Poppy use Poppy E Heroic Charge is your chance to close the distance. Once Poppy W Steadfast Presence also ends, close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge and stop her escape with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Watch the low-health minion positions in case you need to retreat, and use Irelia Q Bladesurge resets to dash back out through minions.
Poppy.phase: You get stronger as you build items, but avoid stacking deaths through reckless engages.
Poppy.teamfight: After your allies land crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to split the enemy team and block their escape routes. Stun a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then use Irelia Q Bladesurge resets to dive into the back line. While Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don’t dive in with Irelia Q Bladesurge. If you see Poppy R Keeper's Verdict being charged, move out of its path.
Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy's main damage sources: Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on max health, so be cautious about stacking health alone. Don't spend extra resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, it blocks Irelia Q Bladesurge's dash and briefly prevents you from using movement abilities, so wait it out or approach on foot. Stand in open space to avoid being knocked into a wall by Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you're hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, leave the area before the second explosion. When you see Poppy R Keeper's Verdict charging, move sideways out of its path.

Olaf.build: Build armor first to mitigate Olaf Q Undertow’s physical damage. However, Olaf Q Undertow reduces armor, and resistances do not affect Olaf E Reckless Swing’s true damage, so build health as well. Since basic attacks and attack speed are central to his damage, reducing his attack speed is also effective.
Olaf.fight: Build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks in advance, then take short trades by going in and backing out. Even as Olaf’s health decreases, his attack speed and healing grow stronger, so don’t recklessly fight him to the finish. After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, go back in and stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet.
Olaf.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge only on low-health minions to secure resets and an escape route. When Olaf Q Undertow’s axe lands, move to the opposite side so Olaf can’t pick it up.
Olaf.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance. The E mark resets Q’s cooldown, so use a second Q to stick to him when needed.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no ability to create distance on his own, so the window after Olaf R Ragnarok ends is your chance to catch him with Irelia E Flawless Duet.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early, so Irelia must avoid giving up early kills. Irelia gets stronger as the game goes on and she completes items, while Olaf becomes relatively weaker, so don’t throw away your scaling with reckless engages.
Olaf.teamfight: If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance and wait for it to end. After your team lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the enemy formation and cut off escape routes, then repeatedly engage on the marked target with Irelia Q Bladesurge after binding them with Irelia E Flawless Duet.
Olaf.watch: Being hit by Olaf Q Undertow slows you and reduces your armor, so move opposite the direction the axe lands to make it harder for him to retrieve it and re-engage. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, so relying on armor alone when your health is low is dangerous. When Olaf R Ragnarok is active, Irelia E Flawless Duet's stun won't work, so keep your distance and use it after Ragnarok ends.

Orianna.watch: After Orianna moves her ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack, stay away from the area around it. You can be pulled in by Orianna R Command: Shockwave there, and you also need to watch out for the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Orianna.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to survive the early game. Orianna deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Orianna.fight: Right after Orianna moves her ball away from herself with Orianna Q Command: Attack, she lacks the lasting defensive stats from Orianna E Command: Protect, giving you a chance to engage.
Orianna.laning: Rather than forcing your way onto ranged Orianna, farm by using Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish. Watch for waves that let you chain Q resets, and avoid engaging if you might waste Irelia E Flawless Duet.
Orianna.combo: When the E mark lands, Q’s cooldown resets, so you can use Q once more before the stun wears off.
Orianna.escape: Engage when Orianna R Command: Shockwave and Orianna W Command: Dissonance are down and the ball is far away. Check the chain path for Irelia Q Bladesurge through low-health minions before going in so you have an escape route too.
Orianna.teamfight: Stand away from Orianna’s ball, and engage after your team lands crowd control. Use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to block Orianna’s escape route, bind her with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge.

Qiyana.watch: Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal can root you with the river element and let her stealth with the brush element, so adjust your distance based on the element she holds. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes and stuns when it hits a wall or terrain, so don’t stand with your back to a wall and avoid riverbanks and narrow passages. If Qiyana dives in, reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Qiyana.build: Qiyana’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Don’t build magic resistance just for the magic damage from Qiyana W Terrashape.
Qiyana.fight: Build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks in advance on minions, then take short trades by going in and backing out. If Qiyana stays in front of you right after using her combo, mitigate the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance, then counterattack. When both Qiyana W Terrashape and E Audacity are down, bind her with Irelia E Flawless Duet and follow with Q Bladesurge.
Qiyana.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to reset its cooldown, and first check whether there are minions to ride when going in or backing out. If Qiyana holds the river element, move out of range of Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal.
Qiyana.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use W Defiant Dance. Q Bladesurge’s cooldown resets on a marked Qiyana, so you can follow up with consecutive casts.
Qiyana.escape: If only Qiyana W Terrashape is down, she can still escape with E Audacity, so don’t rush your engage. Once both of her mobility abilities are down, close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge and stun her with E Flawless Duet before Qiyana E Audacity comes back up. Be wary of the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal when she holds the river element as you look for an opening.
Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so don’t give her an advantage with reckless engages in the early and mid game. In the late game, Irelia gets stronger as she completes items while Qiyana becomes relatively weaker, so build defensive stats and move with your team.
Qiyana.teamfight: Stand away from walls and riverbanks to reduce the angles for Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent to hit terrain. After your team lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the enemy formation and block escape routes. Bind the trapped target with E Flawless Duet, then dive in with consecutive casts of Q Bladesurge.

Ornn.build: The source doesn’t specify a first purchase item. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so building only one type of resistance leaves you exposed to the other damage type. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your maximum health, so be wary of choices that add a lot of health alone.
Ornn.fight: Fight away from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture’s pillar and from walls, and interrupt Ornn’s counterattack with Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you have to take his attack, reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Ornn.laning: Finish low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge to reset its cooldown, and first check the minion positions you can use to engage and retreat. Don’t start an engage by using Irelia Q Bladesurge on an unmarked Ornn. If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane with Ornn P Living Forge, get on him and interrupt the crafting to build an early lead.
Ornn.combo: Using Irelia Q Bladesurge on a marked Ornn resets its cooldown, so you can follow up again. Save Irelia W Defiant Dance for when you take Ornn’s counterattack instead of using it for damage first.
Ornn.escape: Don’t go in just because Ornn E Searing Charge is down; check whether Ornn R Call of the Forge God is still available. In particular, before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes back up, use Irelia Q Bladesurge to close the gap while Ornn’s mobility is down, then bind him with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Don’t move forward while Ornn W Bellows Breath has made you Brittle.
Ornn.phase: Ornn accumulates items and masterwork upgrades for his allies, so get ahead early and keep up the pressure before those build up.
Ornn.teamfight: When Ornn R Call of the Forge God approaches, dodge the spirit’s first movement to the side, and stay out of the straight line where Ornn can redirect it. After your team lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the enemy formation, then bind a target with Irelia E Flawless Duet and follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge. If you have to take Ornn’s counterattack after engaging, reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Ornn.watch: Near walls or the pillar left by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, Ornn E Searing Charge can knock you up, so move toward open ground. If the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you brittle, keep your distance to avoid the extra damage and long crowd control. Ornn R Call of the Forge God can be recast even after the spirit first passes, so move out of the line between the spirit and Ornn.

Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, move out of her basic attack range to avoid the empowered attack. Dodge Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind minions, and don’t cast Irelia E Flawless Duet while your vision is reduced. Quinn E Vault knocks Irelia back, so don’t force an engage before Quinn uses it.
Quinn.build: Prioritize armor in your early purchases. Quinn P Harrier, Quinn Q Blinding Assault, and Quinn E Vault all deal physical damage, so armor is more effective than magic resistance.
Quinn.fight: Start a trade right after Quinn E Vault is down. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on a low-health minion to close the gap, stun Quinn with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then use the mark to follow up with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Before fighting, build stacks of Irelia P Ionian Fervor by hitting minions with abilities.
Quinn.laning: Quinn outranges you early, so preserve your health and collect CS. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge only on minions you can finish, leaving a path for chained dashes. Farm when Quinn P Harrier has not marked you, and look to trade when Quinn E Vault is down or your jungler arrives.
Quinn.combo: Then dash to the marked Quinn with Irelia Q Bladesurge and land a basic attack, then follow up with the reset Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Quinn retaliates or a gank comes in, reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Quinn.escape: The window to engage opens right after Quinn E Vault is down. Close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge and pin Quinn down with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Before going in, check the positions of low-health minions so you have an escape route with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Quinn.phase: In the early laning phase, focus on preserving your health and scaling against Quinn’s range advantage.
Quinn.teamfight: After an ally’s crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to cut off Quinn’s escape route, then follow up with Irelia E Flawless Duet and Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Quinn comes in from the side, lock her down with crowd control and take her out with your team.

Renekton.watch: When Renekton’s Fury from Renekton P Reign of Anger is above or just below half full, stay out of range and watch for the stun from empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Renekton E Slice and Dice can use minions as a stepping stone to dash twice, so don’t stand among or behind a group of minions.
Renekton.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice. If Renekton Q Cull the Meek’s healing keeps negating your short trades, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice reduces armor, so position to dodge the dash rather than stacking more armor alone.
Renekton.fight: Before fighting, build stacks of Irelia P Ionian Fervor by hitting minions with abilities, then go in briefly and back off. Retaliate when Renekton has no Fury or after he has used Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice. Save Irelia E Flawless Duet to interrupt Renekton when he retaliates or escapes.
Renekton.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge only on minions you can finish to preserve resets and a path for movement. Watch for Renekton stepping forward to build Fury, but don’t stand among or behind a group of minions he can use to dash with Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Renekton.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge for a basic attack and use Irelia W Defiant Dance. Use the mark from the stun with Irelia Q Bladesurge to continue with the reset dash.
Renekton.escape: The moment after Renekton uses Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage is your window to close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge and catch him with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Make sure Renekton W Ruthless Predator’s stun is also down before engaging. When retreating, first check whether you can finish a low-health minion with Irelia Q Bladesurge to keep moving.
Renekton.phase: From the mid game onward, avoid giving up kills and keep scaling while Renekton’s value declines; Irelia grows stronger as she gets items.
Renekton.teamfight: After an ally’s crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to split the enemy formation, including Renekton. Pin the trapped targets down with Irelia E Flawless Duet and dive into the backline with chained Irelia Q Bladesurge dashes. If Renekton uses his abilities first after you engage, reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance.

Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter deals damage based on max health at close range, so don’t stay near him for long. If you’re hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, use Irelia Q Bladesurge to create distance before the second shot applies a stronger slow and magic resistance reduction. After Rumble W Scrap Shield activates, briefly hold your attack until the shield disappears.
Rumble.build: Hold on early with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Rumble’s main damage is magic, and Rumble E Electro Harpoon reduces magic resistance, so choose defensive items with magic resistance instead of ones that only add health.
Rumble.fight: Build stacks of Irelia P Ionian Fervor using minions, then trade with a brief engage and retreat. Wait out the shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield, then stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet and follow up with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Avoid trades that keep you in Rumble Q Flamespitter’s range for long.
Rumble.laning: Set up a situation where Rumble has to walk forward to reach you, and finish low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge to leave a path for engaging or retreating. Don’t waste Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can’t finish.
Rumble.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge for a basic attack and use Irelia W Defiant Dance. Irelia Q Bladesurge resets when used on a marked Rumble, letting you follow up again.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility, so the window to catch him is after Rumble W Scrap Shield’s shield disappears. If you were hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, use Irelia Q Bladesurge to retreat before the second shot arrives. When you have an angle to pin Rumble down, stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet before engaging.
Rumble.phase: From the mid game onward, Irelia grows stronger as she gets items, but avoid dying through reckless engages.
Rumble.teamfight: After an ally’s crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to split the formation where Rumble is positioned. Pin the trapped targets down with Irelia E Flawless Duet and use chained Irelia Q Bladesurge dashes off the marks to reach the backline. In areas slowed by Rumble R The Equalizer, reduce incoming damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance.

Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings is dangerous because of its chained dashes and knock-up, so back away when you see the first dash. Just after Riven gets on you, use Irelia E Flawless Duet to interrupt the rest of her combo. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her attack damage and range increase, and her execute damage scales with your missing health, so keep your distance until it expires.
Riven.build: Riven’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If Riven is getting ahead, move defensive items earlier in your build, and get enough health to avoid being finished off by Riven R Blade of the Exile.
Riven.fight: Build stacks of Irelia P Ionian Fervor in advance using minions, then trade with a brief engage and retreat. The moment after Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions is your chance to retaliate. Don’t use Irelia E Flawless Duet first; save it for when Riven engages and retaliates or retreats.
Riven.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to maintain its cooldown reset. Check the wave first for minions you can use to engage and escape.
Riven.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge for a basic attack and use Irelia W Defiant Dance. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge, reset by the mark from Irelia E Flawless Duet, to follow Riven.
Riven.escape: Look to engage before Riven Q Broken Wings comes back up. If only Riven E Valor is down, she can still escape with Riven Q Broken Wings, so track both mobility abilities. When an opening appears, close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge and cut off her escape with Irelia E Flawless Duet.
Riven.teamfight: After an ally’s crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to split the enemy formation, including Riven. Pin the trapped targets down with Irelia E Flawless Duet and dive in with successive Irelia Q Bladesurge dashes. If Riven dives in first, reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance and ride out her combo.
Riven.phase: Even after the mid game, keep your distance while Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, and avoid forcing engages and falling behind in your growth.

Ryze.watch: Prioritize dodging Ryze E Spell Flux. If it marks you, Ryze W Rune Prison becomes a root and Ryze Q Overload deals increased damage. If you’re marked, move away from your allies until it wears off.
Ryze.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Ryze’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. If you get rooted as soon as you engage and die before you can use Irelia W Defiant Dance, buy a Quicksilver Sash.
Ryze.fight: Before a fight, build stacks of Irelia P Ionian Fervor by hitting minions with abilities. Stun Ryze with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge and follow up with basic attacks. Don’t force an engage while marked by Ryze E Spell Flux.
Ryze.combo: Place the first blade of Irelia E Flawless Duet behind Ryze or along his escape route, then stun him with the second. Follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge to dash in, basic attacks, and Irelia W Defiant Dance. Use the Irelia Q Bladesurge reset from Irelia E Flawless Duet’s mark to keep chasing.
Ryze.escape: If you dodge Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze W Rune Prison only slows you, so close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge and catch him with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Before going in, check the minion positions and secure an escape route for Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Ryze.teamfight: After an ally’s crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to block escape routes on Ryze’s side and engage. Catch him with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge and basic attacks. If Ryze E Spell Flux marks you, move away from your allies. Use Irelia W Defiant Dance as Ryze’s damage hits.
Ryze.laning: Against ranged Ryze, farm by finishing low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge instead of forcing trades. Use minion kills to reset the cooldown and keep a path open; do not use Irelia Q Bladesurge first on Ryze without a mark. While Ryze lacks mana and damage early, pressure him when you have a safe angle to slow his growth.
Ryze.phase: As both sides get more items, they become more threatening, so avoid reckless engages that stunt your growth.

Sett.watch: Sett E Facebreaker stuns if enemies are on both sides of him, so don’t stand with Sett between you and a minion wave. Sett W Haymaker is especially dangerous right after he takes damage: deal your damage, then briefly back off. When he activates it, move sideways out of the center of its aiming line. Sett R The Show Stopper suppresses you if it catches you, so don’t force an engage in front of Sett while his ultimate is available.
Sett.build: Build armor first against Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Resistance can’t block the true damage at the center of Sett W Haymaker, and Sett Q Knuckle Down scales with your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health; focus on avoiding the center.
Sett.fight: Build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks on minions beforehand, then take short trades and back off. Use Irelia E Flawless Duet to stop Sett from retaliating or escaping. After dealing damage, create distance while Sett W Haymaker’s grit fades. Check that you have room to dodge Sett W Haymaker and a minion to escape to with Irelia Q Bladesurge before engaging again.
Sett.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to reset its cooldown and preserve an escape route. Avoid standing on the opposite side of Sett from a minion wave, where Sett E Facebreaker could stun you.
Sett.combo: Keep chaining Irelia Q Bladesurge resets from marks, but move out of the center of Sett W Haymaker when it comes out. Don’t use Irelia W Defiant Dance for damage first; save it to absorb Sett’s retaliation.
Sett.teamfight: After an ally’s crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the enemy formation around Sett and block escape routes. Catch a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then use the mark to chain Irelia Q Bladesurge engages. Avoid the center of Sett W Haymaker, and watch your positioning so Sett R The Show Stopper doesn’t catch you and throw you toward your allies.
Sett.escape: If Sett E Facebreaker is also down, lock him down with Irelia E Flawless Duet and close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Before going in, check for low-health minions so you have an escape route with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Sett.phase: Irelia gets stronger as she builds items, but check your engage path first so you do not die to a reckless engage.

Singed.watch: You can’t dash with Irelia Q Bladesurge while standing on Singed W Mega Adhesive, so go around the adhesive. If Singed E Fling hits you while you’re on it, a root follows, so keep your distance especially when Singed’s team is behind him. Don’t chase even a low-health Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail.
Singed.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Singed’s main damage is magic damage, and Irelia has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Singed.fight: Build your passive stacks beforehand, then take short trades and back off. From an angle that avoids Singed W Mega Adhesive, stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet, close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, and follow up with basic attacks. Save Irelia E Flawless Duet to stop Singed when he retaliates or runs away.
Singed.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to reset it and preserve an escape route.
Singed.combo: Then dash to the marked Singed with Irelia Q Bladesurge and deal basic attacks. Use Irelia W Defiant Dance when you need to absorb his retaliation. The mark resets Irelia Q Bladesurge’s cooldown, so check Singed’s position and the adhesive on the ground before using Q again.
Singed.escape: Once Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling are down, engage during a window when there’s no adhesive underfoot. Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so catch him with Irelia E Flawless Duet and close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Before disengaging, check the wave for a low-health minion you can finish with Q.
Singed.teamfight: If Singed runs at you, catch him with Irelia E Flawless Duet and target his allies instead of chasing him to the end. After an ally’s crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the enemy formation and block their escape route, then engage with Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Singed R Insanity Potion is active, Singed Q Poison Trail also reduces healing, so don’t stay in the poison.
Singed.phase: Singed is hard to catch once he has his core items in the mid-to-late game, so avoid reckless engages or chases that stunt your growth.

Sion.watch: Sion Q Decimating Smash becomes more dangerous the longer it charges, knocking you up and stunning you, so move sideways or interrupt the charge with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught charges in a nearly straight line, so avoid narrow paths and sidestep. After Sion falls, Sion P Glory in Death lets him attack again, so don’t keep fighting in the same spot.
Sion.build: Build armor first against the damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor, so dodge his abilities instead of relying only on items. Sion P Glory in Death deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on a large health stack.
Sion.fight: Build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks on minions beforehand, then take short trades and back off. When Sion W Soul Furnace activates, focus your damage immediately to break the shield. When Sion Q Decimating Smash begins, dodge sideways or interrupt it with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Don’t engage Sion first with Irelia Q Bladesurge without a mark.
Sion.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can kill to reset it and secure a path to move through. If you keep giving Sion CS, his maximum health increases, so push the lane to disrupt his farming or create an advantage in another lane.
Sion.combo: Use the reset Irelia Q Bladesurge to catch up again, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance against Sion’s retaliation.
Sion.escape: If Sion Q Decimating Smash is also down, catch him with Irelia E Flawless Duet and close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Before disengaging, check for a minion you can kill and plan a reset route for Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Sion.phase: At the same time, Sion keeps increasing his maximum health through CS, so in the mid to late game you need to disrupt his farming or create an advantage elsewhere.
Sion.teamfight: After an ally’s crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the enemy formation, catch them with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Avoid the paths of Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught as you engage. If Sion falls, reposition and wait out Sion P Glory in Death.

Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact stuns you if it hits a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one. Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval’s empowered attacks are dangerous at close range, so create distance after trading. Skarner R Impale suppresses you, and Irelia Q Bladesurge cannot break it, so don’t force an engage within its range.
Skarner.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance against Skarner’s main damage. Decide in advance whether to build Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to deal with Skarner R Impale’s suppression.
Skarner.fight: Build stacks of Irelia P Ionian Fervor in advance and repeat short trades where you go in and back out. Right after baiting Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge and cut off his escape with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Don’t use Irelia W Defiant Dance too early; activate it when he retaliates.
Skarner.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge to finish low-health minions and reset its cooldown, and leave a minion to ride when you retreat. Position in open space so Skarner E Ixtal's Impact can’t slam you into a wall.
Skarner.escape: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is a mobility tool, so the moment after he uses it is your window to engage. If you’re stunned by a wall collision, Skarner E Ixtal's Impact comes back sooner, so account for his next engage and back off. While Skarner R Impale is available, don’t go deep assuming Irelia Q Bladesurge will get you out.
Skarner.phase: From the mid game onward, Irelia gets stronger as she completes items, but Skarner’s tank items also contribute to his damage. Use early control and objectives to delay Skarner’s item timings, and don’t throw away your growth with forced engages.
Skarner.teamfight: After your team’s crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to split the enemy team, then bind a target with Irelia E Flawless Duet and follow up with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Keep space between Skarner and his allies, mindful of Skarner R Impale’s range. Be careful near the edges of the dragon or Baron pit so Skarner R Impale can’t drag you in.
Skarner.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge and basic attack; use Irelia W Defiant Dance against his counterattack.

Sylas.watch: If a chain hits you, it knocks you up and lets Sylas follow with more attacks, so be ready to dodge it with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Even if Sylas Q Chain Lash only clips you with its first hit, leave the chains’ intersection point immediately because it explodes after a delay.
Sylas.build: Sylas deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If Sylas W Kingslayer’s healing keeps negating your short trades, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Sylas.fight: Build stacks of Irelia P Ionian Fervor in advance and repeat short trades where you go in and back out. Save Irelia E Flawless Duet to interrupt Sylas when he retaliates or retreats. After Sylas has used W Kingslayer and fully spent E Abscond/Abduct, mark him and follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge, especially before his E comes back.
Sylas.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to reset its cooldown, and leave a minion to ride when going in or retreating.
Sylas.escape: After Sylas has used W Kingslayer and fully spent E, the window to engage is before E comes back. At that point, stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Sylas.phase: From the mid game onward, let the enemy use their abilities first, then absorb them with Irelia W Defiant Dance. Avoid forced engages so Irelia can keep scaling as she completes items.
Sylas.teamfight: After your team’s crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to block Sylas’s escape route and split the enemy team. Right after Sylas dives in with E Abscond/Abduct, stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet and focus him down before he can heal with W Kingslayer. Chain Irelia Q Bladesurge on marked targets to reach the back line.
Sylas.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, basic attack, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance. Hitting a target marked by E with Q resets its cooldown, so you can follow up once more with Q before the stun wears off.

Shen.watch: If taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you’ll take empowered attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault, so look to counterattack right after dodging the dash. You can also reduce damage by moving out of the path of Shen Q Twilight Assault’s returning spirit blade. Shen W Spirit's Refuge negates Irelia’s basic attacks while active, so wait for it to end before using basic attacks.
Shen.build: The time you’re held by Shen E Shadow Dash’s taunt is dangerous, so prioritize tenacity. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don’t focus on only one type of resistance. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health without anything else.
Shen.fight: Build stacks of Irelia P Ionian Fervor in advance by hitting minions with abilities, and repeat short trades where you go in and back out. If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge, and use Irelia E Flawless Duet to interrupt Shen’s retaliation or escape. When Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, hold your basic attacks and resume once it ends.
Shen.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to maintain its reset, and check the minion positions you can use to engage and disengage. If you push the lane and keep Shen occupied with CS, you can punish him for using Shen R Stand United to intervene in another lane.
Shen.combo: Hitting a marked target with Irelia Q Bladesurge resets its cooldown, letting you follow up repeatedly. Land basic attacks after Shen W Spirit's Refuge ends, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance to reduce damage when Shen retaliates or a gank comes in.
Shen.escape: The moment after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is your chance to engage. If Shen R Stand United is also unavailable, close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge and block his escape with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Before going in, check for a low-health minion you can ride with Irelia Q Bladesurge to disengage.
Shen.phase: After that, Irelia gets stronger as she completes items, but repeated deaths from forced engages will stall your growth.
Shen.teamfight: Shen can join with Shen R Stand United, so alert your team immediately if Shen disappears or shows a channeling animation. In fights, wait for your allies’ crowd control to land, then use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to split the enemy formation and cut off their escape route. Lock down a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet and chain in with Irelia Q Bladesurge.

Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere lands between Syndra and Irelia, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can knock the sphere into you and stun you, so move off its line. When several Syndra Q Dark Spheres are on the ground, Syndra R Unleashed Power becomes more dangerous, so reposition. At low health, watch out for Syndra R Unleashed Power’s execute.
Syndra.build: Survive first with a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance against Syndra’s main damage, while also considering your total health because of the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.fight: Just before a fight, build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks by hitting minions with abilities, and go in when Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down. Don’t dash at Syndra first with Irelia Q Bladesurge without a mark.
Syndra.laning: Rather than forcing your way onto ranged Syndra, safely collect CS by chaining Irelia Q Bladesurge through minions. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to maintain its reset, and watch the wave positioning you can use to engage or retreat. Getting boots early helps you walk out of the way of Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
Syndra.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance. Irelia E Flawless Duet’s mark resets Irelia Q Bladesurge’s cooldown, letting you follow up repeatedly.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak has a long cooldown and is her only self-peel, so the moment after she uses it is your chance to engage. Move off the sphere’s line, stun her with Irelia E Flawless Duet, and close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Syndra.phase: After that, Irelia gets stronger as she completes items, but if Syndra’s ability effects change, reposition with the empowered effects in mind.
Syndra.teamfight: When several Syndra Q Dark Spheres are on the ground, watch out for Syndra R Unleashed Power and reposition. After your team’s crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to split the enemy team and block escape routes. Bind a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then chain Irelia Q Bladesurge to dive into the back line.

Talon.watch: Talon W Rake can set up a dangerous Talon P Blade's End combo if both hits land, so if the first hit connects, move out of the returning blades’ path. When Talon dives in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, reduce the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance. Don’t chase recklessly while Talon R Shadow Assault is available, since he can escape with stealth.
Talon.build: Since all of Talon’s damage is physical, start with an armor item such as Cloth Armor. Then build armor and health together to gain enough effective health to withstand Talon’s flat penetration.
Talon.fight: Right after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet and close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Talon dives in first, absorb it with Irelia W Defiant Dance, then counterattack.
Talon.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions you can finish to leave yourself a path to move along. If Talon roams, share his position, ward his jungle routes, and push the lane to make him return to farm.
Talon.combo: Follow up with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land an auto attack, then use Irelia W Defiant Dance. If Irelia E Flawless Duet’s mark resets Irelia Q Bladesurge’s cooldown, you can stick to him again.
Talon.escape: The window to go in with Irelia Q Bladesurge is right after you bait out Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. Hit him with Irelia E Flawless Duet to lock him down. If Talon R Shadow Assault is already on cooldown, it’s a good time to counterattack.
Talon.phase: In the mid game, avoid forcing engages and limit Talon’s roams with vision and lane pressure. Talon has less influence in the late game, so group up for fights.
Talon.teamfight: If Talon dives onto your back line, group with your allies and stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet. When going in to attack, wait for your allies’ crowd control to land first, then use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to split the enemy team and follow up with Irelia E Flawless Duet and Irelia Q Bladesurge.

TahmKench.watch: If you’ve been hit twice, create distance and wait for the stacks to disappear. If you see the animation for Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, spread out from nearby allies to avoid the area knock-up.
TahmKench.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Tahm Kench’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If his healing negates trades or fights drag on, slot Executioner's Calling between your core items.
TahmKench.fight: Build up Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks in advance and look for a time when Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has no stacks. Small hit-and-run trades have little effect because of Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s shield and healing, so commit when you can deal your damage all at once. Stun Tahm Kench with Irelia E Flawless Duet when he tries to counterattack or escape.
TahmKench.laning: Use Irelia Q Bladesurge only on low-health minions to maintain resets, and check the minion positions first to make sure you have a path in and out. Don’t engage by using Irelia Q Bladesurge first on Tahm Kench when he has no mark. If you’re hit twice by Tahm Kench’s auto attacks or Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, back off until the stacks disappear.
TahmKench.combo: Follow up with an auto attack, then use Irelia W Defiant Dance. If Irelia Q Bladesurge hits the stun mark and resets, you can use it again.
TahmKench.escape: The window to engage is after Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is on cooldown. If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has no stacks and you can deal your damage all at once, lock him down with Irelia E Flawless Duet and close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Delay the engage if there are no minions to escape to.
TahmKench.teamfight: After your allies’ crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to block the escape route of the target Tahm Kench is protecting, then follow up with Irelia E Flawless Duet and Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Tahm Kench R Devour is available, he can swallow the target, so don’t use all your finishing abilities at once. If the target is swallowed, pressure with an area ability such as Irelia W Defiant Dance or focus your damage on Tahm Kench.
TahmKench.phase: You get stronger as you build items, but avoid reckless engages that stunt your growth.

Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates basic attacks, so stop auto attacking and use abilities or back off when you’re hit. Even one hit from Teemo E Toxic Shot applies ongoing poison damage, so stay out of range if you aren’t ready to engage. Also watch out for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare in bushes where you have no vision and Teemo R Noxious Trap hidden along your route.
Teemo.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Teemo’s main damage is magic, and Irelia has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Teemo.fight: Right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is on cooldown, check whether there’s a minion you can finish, then close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge. If you commit, avoid a trade where you only take damage from Teemo E Toxic Shot and back off; lock him down with Irelia E Flawless Duet and attack.
Teemo.laning: Don’t force an engage on ranged Teemo. Safely scale by finishing low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Maintain Irelia Q Bladesurge resets and leave a minion path for engaging and retreating. Don’t walk straight past a bush without vision; use a Control Ward or take another route.
Teemo.combo: If Teemo Q Blinding Dart is on cooldown, follow up with auto attacks and use Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Teemo.escape: Right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is on cooldown is your chance to engage and land auto attacks. Teemo W Move Quick increases his movement speed but is not a dash, so stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then follow up with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Before engaging, check for low-health minions so you have a way out with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Teemo.phase: From the mid game onward, push the lane and pressure Teemo with your allied jungler so he has no time to set up Teemo R Noxious Trap, but don’t lose opportunities to scale by engaging recklessly.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap near objectives and in narrow paths as you move. After your allies’ crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to split the enemy team and cut off their escape routes. Lock down a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then use Irelia Q Bladesurge repeatedly to dive onto the back line.

Trundle.watch: Inside Trundle W Frozen Domain, Trundle’s attack speed, movement speed, and healing are increased, so step out and wait for it to expire. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks your escape and slows you, so move to the side as soon as it appears. Trundle becomes tankier when he uses Trundle R Subjugate, so create distance while it’s active.
Trundle.build: Build armor first to deal with Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Trundle R Subjugate deals magic damage and reduces resistances, so prioritize creating distance over stacking more resistances. If Trundle’s healing keeps negating short trades, buy Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Trundle.fight: Build up Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks in advance and take short trades by going in and backing out. Don’t fight in Trundle W Frozen Domain; move out of it before engaging again. Interrupt Trundle’s counterattack with Irelia E Flawless Duet, and activate Irelia W Defiant Dance when you take damage.
Trundle.laning: Trundle P King's Tribute restores his health, so if you’ve chunked him, secure an advantage right away or push the lane to force him to recall.
Trundle.combo: When engaging, place the first blade of Irelia E Flawless Duet behind Trundle and stun him with the second. Follow up with Irelia Q Bladesurge and basic attacks, then use Irelia W Defiant Dance when he counterattacks.
Trundle.escape: Engage after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is on cooldown and Trundle W Frozen Domain has expired. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then stick to him with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Before going in, check the positions of low-health minions so you have a way out with Irelia Q Bladesurge if needed.
Trundle.phase: Irelia gets stronger as she builds items, so look for team fights around objectives instead of facing Trundle alone in a side lane for a long time.
Trundle.teamfight: After your allies’ crowd control lands, use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge to split the enemy team. Lock down a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then follow up with Irelia Q Bladesurge to dive onto the back line. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, attack another target or create distance instead of fighting Trundle.

Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere P Battle Fury builds Fury, making his critical strikes and Tryndamere Q Bloodlust healing threatening, so create distance when he keeps hitting minions. If you’re hit by Tryndamere W Mocking Shout and retreating, walk backward while facing him to avoid the slow, then avoid trading basic attacks immediately afterward. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, stop dealing damage and wait it out by stunning him with Irelia E Flawless Duet or creating distance.
Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Thornmail is also effective against an opponent who relies on basic attacks. If Tryndamere Q Bloodlust healing keeps negating your short trades, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Tryndamere.fight: Hit minions with abilities to build stacks of Irelia P Ionian Fervor, then repeatedly trade with brief engages and disengages. Once Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge and stop his escape with Irelia E Flawless Duet.
Tryndamere.laning: Harass Tryndamere early so he cannot build Fury with last hits, then create distance when he starts building it. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge only on minions you can finish to reset its cooldown, and leave a minion route for your escape. Don’t engage first with Irelia Q Bladesurge on Tryndamere without a mark.
Tryndamere.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance. A mark from Irelia E Flawless Duet resets Irelia Q Bladesurge’s cooldown, letting you catch up again when needed.
Tryndamere.escape: The moment after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down is your chance to engage with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Hit him with Irelia E Flawless Duet to stop his escape. Conversely, when Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, stop chasing and create distance by using Irelia Q Bladesurge on a minion you can finish.
Tryndamere.phase: Irelia gets stronger as she completes items in the mid and late game, but don’t try to hold a side lane alone while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is available.
Tryndamere.teamfight: After an ally lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to block Tryndamere’s escape route and engage. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, buy time with Irelia E Flawless Duet or create distance, then attack after it ends. If you need to deal with Tryndamere in a side lane, check the cooldown of Tryndamere R Undying Rage or send more allies.

TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card locks in a Gold Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay out of his basic attack range.
TwistedFate.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots, and prioritize magic resistance over armor afterward as well.
TwistedFate.fight: The moment after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s Gold Card is used is your chance to engage. Before fighting, hit minions with abilities to build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks, then close the gap by using Irelia Q Bladesurge on a minion you can finish. Stun Twisted Fate with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then dash in; don’t use Irelia Q Bladesurge first on Twisted Fate without a mark.
TwistedFate.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance.
TwistedFate.escape: Engage right after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s Gold Card is used.
TwistedFate.phase: From the mid game onward, don’t keep forcing engages; watch Twisted Fate’s card usage before fighting.
TwistedFate.teamfight: After an ally lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to block Twisted Fate’s escape route. Stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet and follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge resets, looking for the moment right after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s Gold Card is used. If you see Twisted Fate R Destiny being cast while he is in range, interrupt his movement with Irelia E Flawless Duet.
TwistedFate.laning: Do not force your way onto ranged opponent Twisted Fate. Farm by finishing low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge to maintain resets and scale. Stand behind minions to avoid Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, and do not waste Irelia E Flawless Duet and leave yourself vulnerable to ganks.

Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge, so if you’re trapped inside, don’t run into the edge; move around inside and wait for it to disappear. Veigar W Dark Matter shows where and when it will land, so watch the ground indicator and move sideways to dodge. If your health is below half, beware of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on your missing health, and move out of range.
Veigar.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Veigar’s damage is mostly magic and Irelia has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Veigar.fight: Just before a fight, hit minions with abilities to build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks, then close the gap by using Irelia Q Bladesurge to finish low-health minions. When Veigar E Event Horizon is down, stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet and attack.
Veigar.laning: If there’s no opening to engage on ranged opponent Veigar, safely farm only minions you can finish with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Dodge Veigar Q Baleful Strike’s harass, and keep moving when you see Veigar W Dark Matter’s ground indicator. Don’t use Irelia E Flawless Duet recklessly; take opportunities to pressure his farming early, before Veigar builds stacks.
Veigar.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and follow up with Irelia Q Bladesurge, reset by a mark. Use Irelia W Defiant Dance as you take damage.
Veigar.escape: Your chance to engage on Veigar is right after Veigar E Event Horizon is down. Close the gap on Veigar, who has no mobility spell, by using Irelia Q Bladesurge through minions, then stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you’re trapped inside Veigar E Event Horizon, don’t run straight into its edge; save Irelia Q Bladesurge to escape.
Veigar.phase: Veigar has low armor and no mobility early, so pressure his farming then. Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power stacks remain permanently, making the matchup harder as the game goes on, so don’t lose your growth by forcing engages in the mid and late game.
Veigar.teamfight: After an ally lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to block Veigar’s escape route and split the enemy team. Stun a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then follow up with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Before a fight over an objective, check Veigar’s position and whether Veigar E Event Horizon has been used.

Urgot.build: Urgot’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Urgot has relatively high armor, so include penetration to increase your damage. Since Urgot P Echoing Flames scales with maximum health, be cautious about choices that add a lot of health alone.
Urgot.fight: Close the gap for a short trade right after Urgot E Disdain is down. Before engaging, hit minions with abilities to build Irelia P Ionian Fervor stacks, then stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet and close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Damage from Urgot’s leg cannons builds up if you stay near him too long, so only take trades that leave you an escape route.
Urgot.laning: Don’t use Irelia Q Bladesurge on minions indiscriminately and lose your means of escape.
Urgot.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, land basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance.
Urgot.escape: The moment after Urgot E Disdain is down is your window to engage. Close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge, then stun him with Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you need to retreat after being hit by Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, use Irelia Q Bladesurge, but first check for a chain of minions you can finish.
Urgot.phase: In the mid and late game, Irelia gets stronger as she completes items, but don’t lose your growth by forcing engages.
Urgot.teamfight: After an ally lands crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the enemy team, including Urgot. Stun a trapped target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge resets to reach the back line. Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so standing with your front line can reduce the chance that allies behind you get pulled.
Urgot.watch: Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stay near him for long. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, you’ll be heavily slowed and focused by Urgot W Purge, so dodge it with Irelia Q Bladesurge or get out of its way as it comes in. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get out of range before your health reaches the execution threshold.

Vex.watch: If Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s Doom indicator is showing, hold Irelia Q Bladesurge. Engage right after Vex uses Doom on the wave or to poke. Vex E Looming Darkness grows larger over distance, so make a short sidestep while within its range. If hit by Vex R Shadow Surge, move toward your allies.
Vex.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Vex’s magic damage early. Choose Mercury’s Treads and prioritize magic resistance.
Vex.fight: Look for an opening after the Doom indicator disappears and Vex W Personal Space is on cooldown. Before trading, hit minions with abilities to stack Irelia P Ionian Fervor, then stun Vex with Irelia E Flawless Duet and close in.
Vex.laning: Don’t force trades against ranged Vex. Use Irelia Q Bladesurge only on minions you can finish to secure CS. Leave minions you can chain Q through to preserve routes for engaging and retreating. Using Irelia E Flawless Duet carelessly leaves you vulnerable to ganks, so save it when there’s no opening.
Vex.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, attack with basic attacks, and use Irelia W Defiant Dance. The E mark resets Q’s cooldown, letting you use Q again before the stun wears off.
Vex.escape: If Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear has been spent and the shield from Vex W Personal Space is also gone, close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge and lock Vex down with Irelia E Flawless Duet.
Vex.teamfight: Move low-health allies outside Vex’s range so they aren’t the first takedown target of Vex R Shadow Surge. After your allies land crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to block Vex’s escape route, then lock Vex down with Irelia E Flawless Duet and follow with Irelia Q Bladesurge. If the mark from Vex R Shadow Surge is on you, move toward your allies so you can focus Vex together when Vex dives in.
Vex.phase: You get stronger as you build items in the mid and late game, but avoid reckless engages that stunt your growth.

Udyr.watch: Be wary of a stun right after Udyr activates Udyr E Blazing Stampede. While Udyr E Blazing Stampede is empowered, Irelia E Flawless Duet cannot stop Udyr’s movement, so stun Udyr after the empowerment ends. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your max health, so don’t stay in melee range and take repeated hits.
Udyr.build: Build armor first to withstand Udyr’s main damage. However, Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both types of damage, so armor alone won’t stop all of it. If Udyr W Iron Mantle’s healing keeps negating your short trades, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Udyr.fight: Before trading, hit minions with abilities to stack Irelia P Ionian Fervor, then make short trades in and out. When Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone, keep up the pressure and don’t give Udyr time to heal. Save Irelia W Defiant Dance to reduce damage when Udyr retaliates instead of using it first.
Udyr.laning: Udyr can appear from the jungle to gank, so ward key paths and jungle entrances, and don’t push forward when Udyr is missing. Finish low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge to reset its cooldown, and check for minions to use when escaping. Don’t engage by using Irelia Q Bladesurge first on Udyr without a mark.
Udyr.combo: Then dash in with Irelia Q Bladesurge and land basic attacks. Use Irelia W Defiant Dance to withstand Udyr’s retaliation. If the mark remains, follow up with the reset Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Udyr.escape: Right after you make Udyr use Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your chance to close the gap with Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s empowerment has ended, stun Udyr with Irelia E Flawless Duet to block the escape route. If you’ve already been stunned by Udyr E Blazing Stampede, use the period when Udyr can’t stun the same target again for a while to retaliate or escape using a minion.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t force a takedown on Udyr first when Udyr has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle. After your allies land crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the enemy formation, then target a vulnerable enemy in the backline with Irelia E Flawless Duet and Irelia Q Bladesurge. Deal with Udyr after you have the numbers advantage.
Udyr.phase: Check Udyr’s gank path and which minions you can use to escape so you don’t die to a reckless engage.

Vladimir.watch: Vladimir W Sanguine Pool can dodge Irelia E Flawless Duet, so look for a stun after the pool ends. When Vladimir E Tides of Blood is charging, put minions between you and Vladimir or move out of range. If you’re affected by Vladimir R Hemoplague, you take increased damage, so re-engage after the effect ends.
Vladimir.build: Use Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads. Vladimir’s damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first. If healing negates your short trades, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items. Consider Blade of The Ruined King for physical damage.
Vladimir.fight: Just before a fight, hit minions with abilities so you can stack Irelia P Ionian Fervor. Bait out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first, then close the gap by finishing a low-health minion with Irelia Q Bladesurge and land Irelia E Flawless Duet. Don’t engage by using Irelia Q Bladesurge first on Vladimir without a mark.
Vladimir.laning: If there’s no opening to engage ranged Vladimir, focus on farming and growing by taking only minions you can finish with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Vladimir.combo: Use Irelia W Defiant Dance when you need to absorb incoming damage.
Vladimir.escape: Right after Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends is your chance to catch Vladimir with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Before engaging, check the position of low-health minions to secure a route in or out with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Vladimir’s movement speed is slowed while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, which also gives you a chance to close the gap.
Vladimir.phase: Vladimir becomes harder to deal with as he scales over time, so capitalize on early gains and don’t throw away your growth by forcing engages.
Vladimir.teamfight: Don’t group with your allies within the area of Vladimir R Hemoplague. If infected, step back until the effect ends. After your allies land crowd control, use Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge to split the formation, lock down a target with Irelia E Flawless Duet, then dive in with Irelia Q Bladesurge.

Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so don’t stand in line with the minion wave; dodge to the side. When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, leave its area immediately instead of continuing the fight there, and avoid the stun. Viktor Q Siphon Power grants a shield and increased movement speed, so reassess the distance you need to chase immediately after Viktor uses it.
